title: External validation of an image-only ultrasound model for delivery-date prediction in four Chilean public hospitals

zh_title: 智利四家公立医院纯超声图像分娩日期预测模型的外部验证
summary: 在智利四家公立医院3788例单胎超声研究中，仅用超声图像的AI预测分娩日期，平均绝对误差6.9天。
key_points: 独立多中心外部验证，2550例妊娠
仅输入超声帧，不用孕周、生物测量等

reason: 独立多中心外部验证、已前瞻部署、样本数千例，属重要档
abstract: Abstract Accurate delivery-date estimation underpins obstetric care, yet conventional dating performs worst where it is most needed: late-presenting pregnancies without reliable early ultrasound or menstrual history, common in public-sector and migrant populations. We report an independent, multicentre external validation of a prospectively deployed, image-only ultrasound artificial-intelligence (AI) system that predicts days to delivery from standard ultrasound frames alone—without gestational age, biometry, demographics, annotations, or any dating input. Across 3,788 singleton studies from 2,550 pregnancies at four Chilean public hospitals, the AI predicted the delivery date with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.9 days (95% confidence interval [CI] 6.7–7.0). Critically, its accuracy was undiminished where conventional dating is structurally weakest: in pregnancies lacking reliable first-trimester dating the AI achieved an MAE of 6.4 days, whereas estimation from the established due date deteriorated to 13.2 days. The model’s high-coverage prediction intervals were well calibrated (96.5% empirical coverage of the approximately 94% interval), supporting a calibrated delivery-date range rather than a single date. Head-to-head within the same studies, the image-only estimate was more accurate than the due date as used in practice in 69% of pregnancies; prespecified sensitivity analyses showed that part of this margin reflects correction of a systematic, population-specific bias in the 280-day convention, with a smaller residual advantage in dispersion. This dating-independent, calibrated estimate could narrow a persistent equity gap for the patients whom conventional dating serves least well.
zh_abstract: 摘要 准确估算分娩日期是产科诊疗的基础，然而传统的孕周推算在最需要的场合表现最差：即晚期就诊、缺乏可靠早期超声或末次月经史的妊娠，这在公立医疗机构和移民人群中很常见。我们报告了对一种已前瞻性部署的、仅基于图像的超声人工智能（AI）系统进行的独立多中心外部验证；该系统仅凭标准超声图像帧即可预测距分娩的天数，无需孕周、生物测量、人口统计学信息、标注或任何孕周推算输入。在智利四家公立医院2,550例妊娠的3,788项单胎检查中，该AI预测分娩日期的平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.9天（95%置信区间[CI] 6.7–7.0）。关键的是，在传统孕周推算结构性最薄弱的情形下，其准确性并未下降：在缺乏可靠孕早期孕周推算的妊娠中，AI的MAE为6.4天，而根据既定预产期进行估算则恶化至13.2天。该模型的高覆盖率预测区间校准良好（约94%区间的实际经验覆盖率为96.5%），支持给出经校准的分娩日期范围，而非单一日期。在相同检查中进行直接比较，在69%的妊娠中，仅基于图像的估算比实际使用的预产期更准确；预先设定的敏感性分析显示，这一优势的一部分反映了对280天惯例中系统性的、人群特异性偏倚的校正，而在离散度方面则存在较小的残余优势。这种不依赖孕周推算的、经校准的估算有望缩小传统孕周推算对其服务最差的患者所存在的持续性公平差距。

abstract: Safe deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography (NCCT) demands high sensitivity and negative predictive value (NPV) across common and uncommon findings requiring clinical attention. Here, we present a collaborative safety net integrating BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model via contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP), with commercial detectors. Every examination remained in the reporting workflow, deprioritized only when no model returned a positive result. In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications. In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20). These findings support generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization under radiologist oversight, with high sensitivity for intracranial findings requiring clinical attention.

title: Deep Learning for AD Risk Screening and Progression Prediction.
zh_title: 深度学习用于阿尔茨海默病风险筛查与进展预测
summary: 基于西方样本预训练的MRI分类器无需重训即在722人中国SILCODE队列中验证，并分析与进展、认知及血浆标志物的关联。

提前2-3年识别90.5%高风险者，并提供个体脑风险图

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The rise of Alzheimer's disease (AD) immunotherapies underscores the need for accessible, time-efficient biomarkers for early diagnosis. MRI-based deep learning shows promise in this regard, yet few models have undergone comprehensive clinical validation. Using the SILCODE cohort (722 Chinese participants, 1,105 scans), we test the transportability of our classifier (pretrained on Western samples) to an independent Chinese cohort without retraining. The associations between risk scores and disease progression, cognitive performance, and plasma biomarkers are examined. In addition, an interpretable framework is developed to generate individualized brain risk maps and identify subtypes. The model classifies AD with an AUC of 0.913 and 95.2% sensitivity, identifying 90.5% of high-risk individuals 2-3 years before clinical diagnosis. Risk scores correlate significantly with cognitive and plasma indices, particularly p-tau 217. Brain risk maps reveal AD subtypes, including a subgroup with rapid cognitive decline. These findings establish a population-robust, clinically relevant MRI-based model for early AD detection and risk stratification.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）免疫疗法的兴起凸显了对可及、省时的早期诊断生物标志物的需求。基于MRI的深度学习在这方面显示出前景，但很少有模型经过全面的临床验证。我们利用SILCODE队列（722名中国参与者，1,105次扫描），在不重新训练的情况下，检验了我们的分类器（在西方样本上预训练）向独立中国队列的可迁移性。我们考察了风险评分与疾病进展、认知表现和血浆生物标志物之间的关联。此外，还开发了一个可解释框架，以生成个体化脑风险图并识别亚型。该模型对AD分类的AUC为0.913，灵敏度为95.2%，可在临床诊断前2-3年识别出90.5%的高风险个体。风险评分与认知指标和血浆指标显著相关，尤其是p-tau 217。脑风险图揭示了AD亚型，包括一个认知快速下降的亚组。这些发现确立了一种适用于不同人群、具有临床相关性的基于MRI的模型，可用于AD早期检测和风险分层。

title: AI-driven multi-horizon risk stratification for heart failure hospitalization in UA with HFpEF: a Chinese multi-center cohort study

summary: 多中心回顾性队列纳入4367例UA合并HFpEF患者，经集成特征筛选训练12种机器学习算法，预测12、24、36个月心衰住院风险并作外部验证。

abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性病管理中的一大挑战，再次发生心力衰竭住院（HFH）的风险较高；尽管已有多中心真实世界数据，用于多时间节点风险评估的人工智能工具仍然有限。这项多中心回顾性队列研究纳入了4367例UA合并HFpEF患者，采用整合LASSO、SVM-RFE和Boruta的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健的预测因子，随后训练十二种机器学习算法，以估计12个月、24个月和36个月时的HFH风险，并进行了外部验证。各时间点的最优模型（ET、GBDT和LightGBM）在训练队列中表现出较强的区分能力，AUC分别为0.818、0.834和0.863；在外部验证中保持了性能，AUC分别为0.839、0.836和0.851。SHAP分析显示，糖尿病、TyG-BMI和NT-proBNP是影响最大的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了一种多时间点机器学习框架，用于UA合并HFpEF患者的HFH风险分层，该框架显示出可接受的校准度，并在决策曲线分析中显示出潜在的临床实用性。仍需在不同人群和医疗体系中开展进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认其临床有效性并支持其转化应用于常规临床实践。

title: Physical Limits to AI Substitution across Physician Specialties — Implications for the Physician Workforce
zh_title: AI替代医师的物理限度：各专科医师劳动力影响
summary: 基于2023年Medicare Part B索赔数据，按服务是否需物理接触分类，估算各专科工作中AI难以替代的比例。
key_points: 分析约450亿美元支付、589,648名医师、56个专科
非E&M服务中物理操作占比随专科而差异很大
皮肤科、骨科等操作型专科受AI替代影响较小
reason: 大规模索赔数据分析劳动力影响，但非AI性能研究，属值得一看档
abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.

title: Deep learning-based detection and classification of airway nodules on CT for early medical intervention.
zh_title: 低剂量CT气道结节的深度学习检测与分类
summary: 回顾性研究在1107例LDCT中纳入1813个气道结节，将肺结节检测网络迁移并加入注意力，在四家医院独立测试，作为二次阅片工具。
key_points: 基于球体中心点匹配网络迁移
907个近端结节训练，738个跨四院测试
评估作为二次阅片工具的临床效用
reason: 回顾性但有多医院独立测试和阅片效用评估，位于5–6档上沿
abstract: [Insights into imaging] Airway lesions are common CT findings in interval and post-screen lung cancers; however, airway nodules are frequently overlooked. Robust artificial intelligence (AI) tools for characterizing airway nodules remain limited. This study aimed to develop and evaluate deep learning-based models for the detection and classification of airway nodules on low-dose CT(LDCT) as a second-reading tool. 1813 segmental and more proximal airway nodules were retrospectively identified from 1107 LDCT of 1043 participants. A sphere-based center-points matching network, first used to establish a lung nodule detection model, was transferred to airway nodules and enhanced by incorporating coordinate and multiscale attention. The model was trained on 907 proximal airway nodules and independently tested on 738 proximal nodules across four hospitals. The clinical utility of the AI tool was evaluated through human-AI interaction. For nodule classification, a 3D SEResNeXt101-based model was trained, validated and tested using 286 airway nodules (121 benign, 165 malignant) with a 6:2:2 split and evaluated in an independent testing dataset. On the independent testing set, the detection model achieved a high sensitivity of 73.7%. Human-AI interaction demonstrated AI assistance significantly improved radiologists' performance, increasing sensitivity from 39.5% to 72.9% and F1-score from 49.4% to 77.2%, while reducing diagnosis time from 83.8 s to 61.8 s. The classification model showed high sensitivities of 82.1%, 71.4%, 94.3%, 72.7% and specificities of 62.7%, 73.9%, 73.9%, 87.5% across multicenter training, validation, testing and independent testing sets, respectively. This AI system significantly enhances the detection and classification of proximal airway nodules, guiding early medical intervention. Question Improved early detection and classification of airway nodules are critical for lung cancer mortality reduction, but AI-based CAD systems targeting airway nodules remain scarce. Findings The DL models for detection and classification of proximal airway nodules on chest CT were developed and assisted radiologists to achieve higher detection accuracy. Critical Relevance Statement The clinical applications of the proposed DL-based system for detecting and classifying proximal airway nodules on chest CT scans help radiologists reduce missed/delayed diagnoses and shorten diagnostic time as a second-reading tool, guiding medical intervention and improving clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 气道病变是间期癌和筛查后肺癌CT表现中的常见发现，但气道结节常被忽视。用于气道结节特征分析的可靠人工智能（AI）工具仍然有限。本研究旨在开发并评估基于深度学习的模型，用于在低剂量CT（LDCT）上检测和分类气道结节，作为二次阅片工具。研究回顾性地从1043名参与者的1107份LDCT中识别出1813个段及更近端的气道结节。首先用于建立肺结节检测模型的基于球体的中心点匹配网络被迁移至气道结节，并通过引入坐标注意力和多尺度注意力加以增强。模型在907个近端气道结节上训练，并在四家医院的738个近端结节上进行独立测试。通过人机交互评估了该AI工具的临床实用性。对于结节分类，使用286个气道结节（121个良性，165个恶性）以6:2:2的比例划分，训练、验证并测试了基于3D SEResNeXt101的模型，并在独立测试数据集中进行评估。在独立测试集上，检测模型取得了73.7%的高敏感度。人机交互显示，AI辅助显著提升了放射科医师的表现，敏感度由39.5%提高到72.9%，F1分数由49.4%提高到77.2%，同时诊断时间由83.8秒缩短至61.8秒。分类模型在多中心训练集、验证集、测试集和独立测试集中的敏感度分别为82.1%、71.4%、94.3%、72.7%，特异度分别为62.7%、73.9%、73.9%、87.5%。该AI系统显著增强了近端气道结节的检测和分类能力，可指导早期医疗干预。问题：改善气道结节的早期检测和分类对降低肺癌死亡率至关重要，但针对气道结节的基于AI的CAD系统仍然稀少。发现：开发了用于胸部CT上近端气道结节检测和分类的深度学习模型，并辅助放射科医师获得了更高的检测准确性。关键相关性声明：所提出的基于深度学习的系统用于胸部CT扫描上近端气道结节的检测和分类，作为二次阅片工具，有助于放射科医师减少漏诊/延迟诊断并缩短诊断时间，从而指导医疗干预并改善临床结局。

title: A spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory underlies glioblastoma heterogeneity.
zh_title: 时空癌细胞轨迹揭示胶质母细胞瘤异质性
summary: Nature 研究构建 12 例胶质母细胞瘤的单细胞与空间多组学图谱，发现癌细胞从发育样状态向胶质损伤反应和缺氧状态的空间转变，并使用深度学习框架映射细胞状态。
key_points: 覆盖12例肿瘤多区域转录、表观与基因组
异质性由空间分布的状态转变驱动
采用新的深度学习框架映射癌细胞状态
reason: 高质量基础研究，但样本仅12例且AI为辅助，属值得一看档
abstract: [Nature] Cancer cells show highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour1-5. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here we generated a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across many regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalizes tumours into distinct tissue microenvironments and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Consistently, using a new deep-learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ, we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue microenvironments. We validate this cellular trajectory by using somatic mutation-based hierarchies in vivo and an experimental patient-derived organoid model ex vivo. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalized myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.
zh_abstract: [Nature] 在胶质母细胞瘤这一无法治愈的脑肿瘤中，癌细胞表现出高度异质性和可塑性的状态1-5。然而，这些恶性状态如何产生，以及它们在不同肿瘤间是否遵循确定的细胞轨迹，目前仍知之甚少。在此，我们构建了一个深度的人类胶质母细胞瘤单细胞和空间多组学图谱，对12例肿瘤的多个区域进行了转录组、表观基因组和基因组的配对分析。我们发现，胶质母细胞瘤的异质性是由癌细胞在空间上呈模式化的转变所驱动的，即从发育样状态转向由胶质细胞损伤反应和缺氧所定义的状态。这一细胞轨迹将肿瘤划分为不同的组织微环境，并在不同肿瘤以及遗传上不同的肿瘤亚克隆中以分子层面保守的方式呈现。与此一致，我们使用一种新的深度学习框架在原位同时定位癌细胞状态和克隆，结果显示肿瘤亚克隆在整个胶质母细胞瘤组织微环境中在空间上精细地相互混杂。我们通过体内基于体细胞突变的层级结构以及离体的实验性患者来源类器官模型验证了这一细胞轨迹。最后，我们表明这一癌细胞轨迹与髓系细胞异质性密切相关，并在区域化的髓系信号环境中展开。我们的发现界定了胶质母细胞瘤中癌细胞的一条刻板轨迹，并将胶质母细胞瘤的肿瘤异质性统一到一个可操作的细胞与组织框架之中。

abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.

abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.

abstract: [Genomics] Predicting patient response to cancer treatments remains a challenge due to tumor heterogeneity and complex tumor microenvironments (TMEs). Modern spatial genomics technologies enable gene expression profiling alongside histological frameworks, but comprehensive analysis and clinical translation of these high-dimensionality datasets will benefit from Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). This review synthesizes computational approaches that address challenges of spatial data by examining deep-learning architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for histological feature extraction and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for modeling cell-cell interactions. We then explore the paradigm of Foundation Models that bridge histopathology with transcriptomics to accelerate the identification of spatially resolved biomarkers, improve patient stratification for immunotherapy and targeted treatments, and advance the clinical translation of mechanistic insights derived from the tumor microenvironment.

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed several areas of ophthalmic practice, most notably diabetic retinopathy screening, where autonomous systems have achieved regulatory approval and real-world deployment. Uveitis, by contrast, remains at an earlier stage in translation. Its heterogeneity, longitudinal disease course and reliance on multimodal clinical reasoning present distinct challenges, compounded by small, fragmented and geographically restricted datasets. This review examines the landscape of AI applications in uveitis and maps them to the established ophthalmic AI validation pipeline, from algorithm development through to clinical deployment. Evidence varies between individual studies: selected vitritis detection and aetiological classification models have undergone independent external testing, while anterior chamber inflammation quantification includes small single-centre feasibility studies. Emerging applications, including recurrent-course prediction, treatment-response modelling, fluorescein angiography segmentation, natural language processing and foundation model fine-tuning, remain predominantly at proof-of-concept stages. Despite encouraging algorithmic performance, the studies discussed have not demonstrated clinical actionability: evidence that an AI output changes a clinical decision, leads to an appropriate management intervention and ultimately improves a patient-relevant outcome. We argue that the principal translational bottleneck is therefore not algorithmic capability alone, but the absence of harmonised longitudinal datasets, geographically diverse validation, prospective evaluation and, critically, studies linking AI output → clinical decision → management intervention → patient outcome. International collaborative registries offer a pathway towards addressing these gaps. The next phase of uveitis AI must move beyond model performance towards clinically actionable systems that improve diagnosis, disease monitoring, treatment selection and relapse prediction, ultimately delivering meaningful benefit to patients with ocular inflammatory disease.

abstract: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.

abstract: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.

abstract: EHR foundation models read medical events within a fixed context window, and long context has so far been measured only in tokens. How far back in time a model must look to capture the earliest predictive signal is unknown. We introduce time-context, the calendar lookback window before the prediction point, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of decade-scale time-context for an EHR foundation model. We pretrained a decoder-only transformer (34.6M parameters) on 1.4B coded events from 3.6M primary-care patients in North West London and fine-tuned it to predict incident colorectal cancer under a 12-month pre-diagnostic buffer. A frozen cohort of 1,008 cases and 9,582 matched controls, all registered for at least 30 years, was evaluated at 15 nested lookback windows from 2 to 30 years, so that every truncation is compared within the same patients. Discrimination rose from an AUROC of 0.551 at 2 years to 0.590 at 18 years, then plateaued, with about 80% of the gain reached within 10 years; an XGBoost baseline converged to the same level (peak AUROC 0.589). A simulation further suggests that rotary position embeddings (RoPE) over elapsed time alias beyond about 20 years at the default base frequency, motivating a retuned $θ$. Time-context is a measurable design axis for clinical prediction models, distinct from token-context, and should be reported.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型在固定的上下文窗口内读取医疗事件，而长上下文迄今仅以token数衡量。模型需要回溯多久才能捕捉到最早的预测信号，目前尚不清楚。我们提出“时间上下文”（time-context），即预测时间点之前的日历回溯窗口，并据我们所知首次对EHR基础模型的十年尺度时间上下文进行了系统评估。我们在来自西北伦敦360万名基层医疗患者的14亿条编码事件上预训练了一个仅解码器的transformer（3460万参数），并对其微调，以在诊断前12个月缓冲期的条件下预测新发结直肠癌。我们使用一个固定的队列（1,008例病例和9,582名匹配对照，均登记至少30年），在从2年到30年的15个嵌套回溯窗口上进行评估，使每一种截断都在相同患者中比较。判别能力从2年时的AUROC 0.551上升至18年时的0.590，随后进入平台期，约80%的增益在10年内达到；XGBoost基线收敛到相同水平（峰值AUROC 0.589）。模拟进一步提示，在默认基频下，基于经过时间的旋转位置编码（RoPE）在约20年以上会发生混叠，这促使重新调整$θ$。时间上下文是临床预测模型中一个可测量的设计维度，有别于token上下文，应当予以报告。

title: SAFE-Teen: Evaluating Chatbot Safety Across Adolescent Mental Health Conversations

abstract: Adolescents are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, advice, and companionship, raising safety concerns. While recent evaluations have started to examine safety across multiple conversational turns, few compare how slight changes in a teen's responses can affect a chatbot's safety in the same scenario. We conduct a clinician-informed evaluation of chatbot safety in simulated conversations with adolescents aged 13-17, examining how safety failures vary with adolescents' responses and teen-aware system prompting. We evaluated 32,555 simulated conversations across 18 chatbot APIs and two system-prompt conditions using 22 safety criteria grounded in previously identified harms. Conversations spanned 983 variants of 106 seed scenarios covering urgent safety issues, health advice, and identity and relationships. The overall criterion failure rate was 43.3% without the teen-aware prompt and 24.9% with it. The teen-aware prompt reduced failures, but it didn't eliminate them. When a teenager pushed back on a chatbot's answer, failures on mental health diagnosis, medication, and substance misuse boundaries rose by 10-12 percentage points without the prompt, for more than 80% of chatbots. These findings reveal persistent safety failures in simulated adolescent-chatbot interactions and show that safety depends on how a conversation unfolds.
zh_abstract: 青少年越来越多地向人工智能聊天机器人寻求心理健康支持、建议和陪伴，由此引发了安全方面的担忧。尽管近期的评估已开始考察多轮对话中的安全性，但很少有研究比较在同一情境下，青少年回应的细微变化如何影响聊天机器人的安全性。我们在模拟的13-17岁青少年对话中，开展了一项有临床专家参与的聊天机器人安全性评估，考察安全性失败如何随青少年的回应及面向青少年的系统提示而变化。我们基于既往已识别的危害，采用22项安全性标准，评估了18个聊天机器人API和两种系统提示条件下的32,555段模拟对话。这些对话涵盖106个种子情境的983个变体，涉及紧急安全问题、健康建议以及身份与人际关系。在没有面向青少年的提示时，总体标准失败率为43.3%；使用该提示时为24.9%。面向青少年的提示减少了失败，但并未消除失败。当青少年对聊天机器人的回答提出反驳时，在没有该提示的情况下，超过80%的聊天机器人在心理健康诊断、药物以及物质滥用边界方面的失败率上升了10-12个百分点。这些发现揭示了模拟的青少年—聊天机器人互动中持续存在的安全性失败，并表明安全性取决于对话如何展开。

title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
zh_title: IVF/ICSI活产预测的机器学习：系统综述、荟萃分析与批判性评价
summary: 系统综述48项研究，仅内部验证模型合并AUC为0.814，后期或外中心验证模型为0.756。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA 2020，采用PROBAST+AI评价
纳入48项研究
内部验证AUC高于外部验证
reason: 纳入48项研究的系统综述，结论明确，综述类上限6
abstract: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. We define what fixes the meaning of a model's output (decision point, endpoint, unit of analysis, data source) and map the 48 included studies by model family, decision point and validation design. Models evaluated only internally pooled to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.814, against 0.756 (95% prediction interval 0.546-0.889) for models evaluated on a later period or another centre, and 0.764 for studies not at high risk of bias; neither difference was significant, and heterogeneity was extreme. Models whose decision point was not stated pooled to 0.910, the only significant moderator in meta-regression. Against logistic regression fitted to the same data, the best machine-learning model gained a pooled 0.056 AUC (95% CI 0.017-0.090). Of 48 studies, 47 were at high or unclear risk of bias, only four assessed the calibration slope, and no model has evidence of clinical impact. The certainty of the pooled evidence is low to very low; the gains that survive validation came from staging predictions to decision points and local calibration, not deeper architectures. We provide a TRIPOD+AI-mapped checklist, a benchmark specification and a research agenda.
zh_abstract: 基于常规临床数据预测体外受精（IVF）或卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）后活产的机器学习模型，其报告的性能从接近随机到接近完美不等。我们依据 PRISMA 2020 对这些模型进行了系统综述，检索了 OpenAlex、Scopus 和 Web of Science（检索至 2026 年 10 月 22 日），采用 PROBAST+AI 和 TRIPOD+AI 进行评价，并在 logit 尺度上用随机效应荟萃分析合并其区分度。我们界定了决定模型输出含义的要素（决策点、终点、分析单位、数据来源），并按模型类别、决策点和验证设计对纳入的 48 项研究进行了归类。仅作内部评估的模型，其受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）合并值为 0.814；而在后续时间段或另一中心评估的模型为 0.756（95% 预测区间 0.546–0.889）；未处于高偏倚风险的研究为 0.764；两项差异均无统计学意义，且异质性极大。未说明决策点的模型合并值为 0.910，这是荟萃回归中唯一显著的调节因素。与在同一数据上拟合的逻辑回归相比，最佳机器学习模型的合并 AUC 增益为 0.056（95% CI 0.017–0.090）。48 项研究中，47 项存在高或不明确的偏倚风险，仅 4 项评估了校准斜率，且没有任何模型有临床影响方面的证据。合并证据的确定性为低至极低；经验证后仍然成立的增益，来自按决策点分阶段进行预测以及本地校准，而非更深的网络架构。我们提供了与 TRIPOD+AI 对应的核查清单、基准规范以及研究议程。

abstract: Drug discovery requires continuous scientific decision-making across a vast research space. We introduce PharmAgents2, an autonomous system for end-to-end drug discovery that combines knowledge-enhanced decision-making with organized large-scale exploration. Paper2Skill extracts transferable scientific decision knowledge from public sources and, together with expert-developed skills, supports research decisions. Self-Scaling Discovery expands exploration through parallel agents inheriting research context and decision-making capabilities across targets, scientific hypotheses, and discovery strategies. We introduce PharmAgents-Bench v0.1, comprising 121 questions across nine decision scenarios and three end-to-end tasks assessed with expert-defined process rubrics. PharmAgents2 outperforms evaluated baselines in most decision categories and achieves the highest process scores on all three end-to-end tasks. In three real-world studies, autonomous investigations generated findings subsequently supported by human-executed experiments. For LpxH, PharmAgents2 hypothesized a previously unreported allosteric site and screened compounds against it, identifying a novel inhibitor scaffold with experimentally confirmed inhibitory activity and binding. For JAK1, it prioritized a covalent inhibition strategy and nominated compounds with experimentally demonstrated activity. Starting from a known bioactive molecule, Self-Scaling Discovery explored candidate targets across the proteome and identified a new binding target, with the interaction subsequently confirmed experimentally. PharmAgents2 represents a prototype of a virtual pharmaceutical company, marking a step toward autonomous end-to-end drug discovery.
zh_abstract: 药物发现需要在庞大的研究空间中持续进行科学决策。我们提出了 PharmAgents2，这是一个用于端到端药物发现的自主系统，它将知识增强的决策与有组织的大规模探索相结合。Paper2Skill 从公开来源中提取可迁移的科学决策知识，并与专家开发的技能一起支持研究决策。Self-Scaling Discovery（自我扩展式发现）通过并行智能体扩展探索范围，这些智能体在不同靶点、科学假设和发现策略之间继承研究背景和决策能力。我们提出了 PharmAgents-Bench v0.1，其包含涵盖九种决策场景的 121 个问题和三项端到端任务，并采用专家定义的过程评分标准进行评估。PharmAgents2 在大多数决策类别中优于所评估的基线方法，并在全部三项端到端任务中获得最高的过程得分。在三项真实世界研究中，自主调查产生的发现随后得到了由人工执行的实验的支持。对于 LpxH，PharmAgents2 提出了一个此前未报道的变构位点的假设，并针对该位点筛选化合物，识别出一种新的抑制剂骨架，其抑制活性和结合经实验证实。对于 JAK1，它优先选择了共价抑制策略，并提名了经实验证明具有活性的化合物。从一个已知的生物活性分子出发，Self-Scaling Discovery 在整个蛋白质组范围内探索候选靶点，并识别出一个新的结合靶点，该相互作用随后经实验证实。PharmAgents2 代表了虚拟制药公司的原型，标志着向自主端到端药物发现迈出了一步。

abstract: [Nature methods] De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

summary: 预印本提出对抗式多模态医学基准，将真实胸片与合成临床照片配对，用于暴露前沿模型的幻觉行为。

abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
zh_abstract: 我们利用医学图像合成构建了一个具有挑战性的多模态评估框架，以揭示前沿模型的幻觉行为。由于现有医学数据集很少将不同图像模态（如X线片与外部临床照片）配对，评估多模态推理一直较为困难。为填补这一空白，我们提出Trick-or-Treat，一个对抗性多模态医学基准，将真实胸部X线片与合成临床照片配对，以挑战模型的跨模态推理能力。针对多种不同病症，我们各创建了两对图像，两对共用同一张胸部X线片，但配以不同的外部照片。在匹配对中，胸部X线片和照片均包含提示同一疾病的表现（例如，肺部阴影和水痘中可见的结痂皮损提示水痘肺炎）。在不匹配对中，照片描绘的是另一种不会导向同一统一诊断的临床表现（例如，将结痂皮损替换为普通痤疮）。合成照片的生成使得临床表现可以变化，而人物特征和拍摄环境保持一致，从而减少混杂。在对三个前沿模型的研究中，我们发现模型在45–57.5%的不匹配对中对照片的具有临床意义的表现产生幻觉，高于同一照片单独呈现时的25–37.5%。面对不匹配对时，模型倾向于忽略不匹配，转而幻想出与X线片更为吻合的表现（例如，将痤疮误读为结痂皮损，以支持水痘的诊断）。Trick-or-Treat既展示了前沿模型医学推理中令人担忧的错误模式，也为在对抗性多模态评估中使用合成图像提供了概念验证。

abstract: Retrieving an enzyme for a target reaction provides a starting point for evolution, but predicting how to improve it remains difficult. This requires connecting evolutionary information with the structural and chemical context of catalysis. Here we present AlphaEnzyme, an enzyme foundation model built on a structure-grounded representation of an enzyme paired with its reaction, from which catalytic compatibility, kinetics and mutational response are read out together. On a time-separated benchmark, AlphaEnzyme achieves a top-1 catalyst retrieval success rate of 30.1%, against 17.2% for the strongest baseline. Michaelis constant predictions achieve the highest rank correlations among the compared methods, reaching 0.64 for enzymes sharing at most 40% identity with the kinetic training set. The model also enriches high-fitness TrpB variants at a budget of 16 candidates without target-specific fitness training. In prospective transaminase engineering, several prioritized variants exceed the parent, with the best design yielding a 30.4-fold increase in product signal in a lysate-based assay while retaining (R)-selectivity. Together, AlphaEnzyme provides a common molecular basis for selecting starting enzymes and prioritizing sequence changes for their improvement.
zh_abstract: 检索针对目标反应的酶可为定向进化提供起点，但预测如何改进该酶仍然困难。这需要将进化信息与催化的结构和化学背景联系起来。在此，我们提出 AlphaEnzyme，一种酶基础模型，其建立在以结构为基础的酶及其反应配对表示之上，可同时读出催化兼容性、动力学和突变响应。在按时间划分的基准测试中，AlphaEnzyme 的 top-1 催化剂检索成功率为 30.1%，而最强基线为 17.2%。米氏常数（Michaelis constant）预测在所比较的方法中取得最高的秩相关性，对于与动力学训练集序列一致性至多为 40% 的酶，相关系数达到 0.64。在无需针对目标的适应度训练的情况下，该模型还能在 16 个候选的预算下富集高适应度的 TrpB 变体。在前瞻性转氨酶工程中，若干优先选出的变体超过了亲本，其中最佳设计在基于裂解液的检测中使产物信号提高 30.4 倍，同时保持 (R)-选择性。总体而言，AlphaEnzyme 为选择起始酶以及优先确定用于改进的序列改变提供了统一的分子基础。

abstract: Protein Language Models (pLMs) have become essential tools for computational protein analysis, and the rapid proliferation of architectures, training objectives, and pretraining corpora has produced a diverse and expanding model landscape. Evaluation practices, however, remain fragmented: studies use different datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and reporting conventions, so results rarely transfer between publications. Here we introduce Protify, an open-source platform that standardizes pLM benchmarking across zero-shot, supervised, and transferlearning settings through a unified, low-code interface. Protify currently supports 35 pretrained models and 61 curated datasets and it is easy to add custom versions of each. Leveraging Protify's high throughput pipelines, we benchmarked 23 models on ProteinGym, discovering that DPLM3B is currently the top-performing self-supervised encoder. Another large-scale supervised evaluation across 32 diverse tasks, spanning enzyme classification, gene ontology annotation, protein-protein interaction, subcellular localization, and other functional properties, found that no single pLM dominated: 14 different models took the top score on at least one dataset, and the margins between the best and second-best models fell within run-to-run variability. On enzyme optimal pH prediction, a general-purpose probe pipeline matched or exceeded EpHod, a specialized model selected from 11,550 training runs, after 50 hyperparameter trials (R2 = 0.482 versus 0.425). Under a homology-controlled split of the same data, every pooled-embedding probe collapsed to near-zero R2, and only a transformer probe over full residue embeddings recovered appreciable signal (R2 = 0.248). Model rankings therefore depend as much on evaluation design as on the models themselves. Protify makes those design choices explicit, controlled, and replayable, and is freely available at https://github.com/Gleghorn-Lab/Protify.

abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] Hallucinations generated by large language models (LLMs) represent an emerging safety top event in radiology, where subtle interpretive errors can rapidly propagate into clinical decisions. Although these systems demonstrate remarkable linguistic fluency, their underlying probabilistic architecture is, in some cases, not aligned with the demands of diagnostic intelligence, factual reliability, or safety standards. This work presents a comprehensive review describing the pathways that lead to hallucinations in radiology domain generative LLMs, mapping the risks derived from model architecture, data quality, black-box opacity, and automation bias. It also identifies the preventive strategies required to control these risks, including legal and governance safeguards, rigorous data curation protocols, explainability and simulation frameworks, and structured human oversight. This review shows how hallucinations may distort diagnostic reasoning, generate fictitious clinical data, and precipitate erroneous management decisions with potential patient harm, underscoring the need for controlled deployment strategies before integrating generative AI into radiological workflows.

abstract: [Journal of gastrointestinal cancer] Gallbladder carcinoma (GBC) is the most common biliary tract malignancy and is usually diagnosed at an advanced stage. Artificial intelligence (AI), including radiomics, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is increasingly applied to its diagnosis, surgical management and prognostication, but how far the reported performance can be trusted is unclear. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library and Google Scholar were searched to 5 May 2026 using database-specific search strategies. Each primary prediction-model study was characterized separately by design, number of centers and validation type (internal, temporal or external). Of 31 primary AI studies in GBC, 29 were retrospective, 22 were single-center and 24 reported internal validation only. In independent test or external cohorts, DL and ML models discriminated benign from malignant gallbladder lesions with areas under the curve (AUCs) of approximately 0.80-0.89; a multicenter model distinguishing xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis from GBC achieved an external AUC of 0.88, and automated computed tomography (CT) segmentation an external Dice score of 0.76. The best recurrence model achieved an AUC of 0.76 on internal (random-split) validation; none of the reviewed prognostic models reported a quantified external-validation estimate. Intraoperative AI is technically feasible but has no outcome data, and federated learning has been tested only in simulation. AI could plausibly assist several steps of GBC care, but the evidence is dominated by retrospective, single-center, internally validated studies from Asia, and metrics from different studies are not directly comparable. Prospective multicenter external validation, shared annotated datasets and standardized reporting are required before clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [胃肠肿瘤杂志] 胆囊癌（GBC）是最常见的胆道恶性肿瘤，通常在晚期才被诊断。人工智能（AI），包括影像组学、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），越来越多地应用于其诊断、手术管理和预后判断，但所报告的性能在多大程度上可信尚不清楚。我们采用针对各数据库的检索策略，检索了截至2026年5月5日的 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane 图书馆和 Google Scholar。对每项原始预测模型研究，分别按设计、中心数量和验证类型（内部验证、时间验证或外部验证）进行了特征描述。在31项胆囊癌原始AI研究中，29项为回顾性研究，22项为单中心研究，24项仅报告了内部验证。在独立测试队列或外部队列中，DL 和 ML 模型区分胆囊良恶性病变的曲线下面积（AUC）约为0.80–0.89；一项区分黄色肉芽肿性胆囊炎与 GBC 的多中心模型的外部 AUC 为0.88，计算机断层扫描（CT）自动分割的外部 Dice 系数为0.76。最佳复发模型在内部（随机划分）验证中的 AUC 为0.76；所纳入的预后模型均未报告量化的外部验证估计值。术中AI在技术上可行，但尚无结局数据，联邦学习仅在模拟中得到测试。AI有可能在胆囊癌诊治的多个环节提供辅助，但现有证据以来自亚洲的回顾性、单中心、仅经内部验证的研究为主，且不同研究的指标不能直接比较。在临床应用之前，需要开展前瞻性多中心外部验证、共享带注释数据集并采用标准化报告。

abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used in brain arteriovenous malformation (AVM) neuroimaging, but translation readiness remains incompletely mapped. To characterize AI-related applications, reported performance, and barriers to clinical deployment. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR-guided review of PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar from inception through 20 December 2025, with PubMed additionally searched on 23 August 2026. Eligible sources addressed AI, machine learning, radiomics, or automated computational analysis of brain AVM imaging. Results were charted descriptively; heterogeneous metrics were not pooled. Thirty-two sources were included: 28 primary reports and four contextual evidence syntheses. Thirteen primary reports had a documented AI/ML component. Of these, seven used imaging-derived inputs only, three combined imaging with clinical or treatment predictors, one compared separate imaging and clinical models, and two had unresolved final predictor sets. Three nidus-segmentation reports gave Dice estimates of 0.754, 0.80 and 0.82; partition details were unavailable for the first, and the last applied to detected lesions. Validation designs and clinical targets varied, precluding a pooled performance estimate. AI/ML shows technical feasibility in selected brain AVM imaging and prediction tasks. Clinical benefit and routine deployment have not been demonstrated. Multicenter institutional validation, calibration, transparent reporting and prospective clinical-impact evaluation remain priorities.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] 人工智能（AI）已被用于脑动静脉畸形（AVM）神经影像学，但其转化就绪程度仍未被完整梳理。本研究旨在描述与AI相关的应用、已报告的性能以及临床部署的障碍。我们按照PRISMA-ScR指南对PubMed、Embase和Google Scholar自建库至2025年12月20日进行了综述检索，并于2026年8月23日对PubMed另行检索。符合条件的来源涉及脑AVM影像的AI、机器学习、影像组学或自动化计算分析。结果以描述性方式整理；异质性指标未进行合并。共纳入32个来源：28篇原始报告和4篇背景性证据综合。其中13篇原始报告有明确记录的AI/机器学习成分。在这13篇中，7篇仅使用影像来源的输入，3篇将影像与临床或治疗预测因子相结合，1篇比较了独立的影像模型和临床模型，2篇的最终预测因子集不明确。3篇病灶（nidus）分割报告给出的Dice估计值分别为0.754、0.80和0.82；第一项研究未提供数据划分细节，最后一项适用于已检出的病灶。验证设计和临床目标各不相同，无法给出合并的性能估计。AI/机器学习在特定的脑AVM影像和预测任务中显示出技术可行性。但其临床获益和常规部署尚未得到证实。多中心的机构验证、校准、透明的报告以及前瞻性临床影响评估仍是优先事项。

abstract: [Therapeutic advances in respiratory disease] Acute exacerbation of interstitial lung disease (AE-ILD) is a life-threatening clinical event associated with poor prognosis. Accurate outcome prediction is important for treatment planning and resource allocation. This review evaluates evidence on prognostic risk factors and clinical scoring systems and discusses the application of artificial intelligence (AI) into the key stages of model development for AE-ILD prognostication. Conventional prognostic approaches enable rapid risk stratification but have limited capacity to integrate heterogeneous data and account for clinical complexity. AI-driven approaches have been preliminarily applied to clinical and imaging data for prognostic assessment. However, direct AE-ILD-specific evidence is limited, and the incremental prognostic value of existing AI models over conventional approaches remains uncertain. Multimodal integration, independent external validation, and model interpretability remain major research gaps. Addressing these gaps through representative multicentre studies may enable AI to reinforce conventional prognostic assessment and promote more individualised risk stratification in AE-ILD.
zh_abstract: [呼吸疾病治疗进展] 间质性肺疾病急性加重（AE-ILD）是一种危及生命的临床事件，预后较差。准确的结局预测对治疗规划和资源分配十分重要。本综述评估了关于预后危险因素和临床评分系统的证据，并讨论了人工智能（AI）在 AE-ILD 预后评估模型开发各关键阶段中的应用。传统预后方法能够实现快速的风险分层，但整合异质性数据和应对临床复杂性的能力有限。AI 驱动的方法已初步应用于临床和影像数据的预后评估。然而，针对 AE-ILD 的直接证据有限，现有 AI 模型相较传统方法的增量预后价值仍不确定。多模态整合、独立的外部验证以及模型可解释性仍是主要的研究空白。通过具有代表性的多中心研究弥补这些空白，可能使 AI 增强传统预后评估，并促进 AE-ILD 更加个体化的风险分层。

abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.
zh_abstract: 研究者将大语言模型（LLM）用作社会模拟中的智能体，通过向智能体提供观察信息和背景信息的提示来塑造其行为。然而，已有研究表明，LLM 智能体在保持含义不变的提示变化下，其行为会发生显著改变，这给社会模拟的验证带来了问题。一种看似合理的假设是，这种脆弱性反映了缺乏落地依据（grounding），可通过丰富提供给智能体的上下文来降低。更丰富的上下文是否能提高稳健性目前仍不清楚，部分原因在于上下文丰富度和稳健性很少以支持对照比较的方式加以定义。针对第一个需求，我们提出了受控上下文丰富化方法，这是一组提示替换规则，可系统性地丰富不同类型的上下文：中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据和规范性决策依据。针对第二个需求，我们提出将选择性稳健性作为一项验证标准：即对保持含义不变的提示变化不敏感，同时对社会世界中与决策相关的变化做出有方向性的响应。我们在一个类囚徒困境博弈中演示了该框架，展示了如何利用它来识别哪些形式的上下文丰富化能产生更理想且更稳健的智能体行为。我们发现，这些丰富化形式会产生不同的行为模式，且这些模式在所测试的两个模型之间存在差异。

title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift

abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
zh_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于癌症诊断模型的临床部署至关重要，然而神经网络和变分高斯过程方法可能产生过度自信的预测，尤其是在于一家医院训练的模型应用于另一家医院时出现的分布偏移情形下。我们提出了一种可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类（Gaussian Process Classification，GPC）框架，该框架基于冻结的病理基础模型嵌入（Phikon），结合了用于低秩核分解的加速随机主元Cholesky分解（Randomly Pivoted Cholesky，RPCholesky）、采用非中心化参数化进行后验采样的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo，HMC），以及用于预测的“主元即诱导点”方案。这使得在约300,000个训练点（N≈300,000）的规模上，对低秩潜在表示进行HMC后验采样成为可行，从而使基于HMC的低秩GPC能够应用于比以往基于MCMC的演示大得多的数据集。我们在两个用于乳腺癌转移检测的组织病理学基准上进行评估：PCam和CAMELYON17-WILDS，其中后者用于检验医院层面分布偏移下的校准性能。与随机变分GP和神经网络基线相比，我们的方法改善了校准和预测性能——期望校准误差最多降低88%，假阴性率最多降低90%——且在分布偏移下收益最大，提示基于HMC的后验采样可为跨机构病理分类提供更可信的不确定性估计。

title: Reclassification Is All You Missed: Surfacing Variant Reinterpretation Need in Online Health Communities at Population Scale
zh_title: 线上健康社区中变异重分类需求的人群规模发现：PRISM智能体
summary: PRISM是基于LLM的智能体流程，筛查390万条社区帖子，核对变异是否被ClinVar重分类，并起草提示信息，处于不联系的模拟运行阶段。
key_points: 分析32个社区共390万条帖子
相关讨论占0.288%，专科遗传社区为6.30%
自2014年以来增长约五倍
reason: 新颖的智能体应用预印本，证据有限，无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Genetic variants are routinely reclassified in ClinVar after a patient is tested, sometimes from uncertain to pathogenic, yet patient recontact is inconsistent, with no clear duty and responsibility diffused among labs, providers, and patients. Many affected people discuss their results in public online health communities that clinical recontact often does not reach. We built PRISM, an agentic large-language-model pipeline that screens these posts, checks whether the variant was later reclassified, and drafts a disclaimer-bearing outreach message, in a no-contact dry run. Across 3.9 million posts from 32 communities, agent-predicted reinterpretation-relevant discussion is rare (0.288%) but concentrated in specialist genetics communities (6.30% versus 0.10% in general medical-advice communities) and growing fivefold since 2014; PRISM surfaces 123 candidate classification differences, 5 of them from an uncertain submission to pathogenic or likely pathogenic. On a held-out set of 30 real-post drafts, a clinician judged 27 factually grounded and 15 fit to send: factual accuracy is necessary but not sufficient for clinically acceptable outreach. PRISM contributes a population-scale reinterpretation-need map with code and data to be released upon publication.
zh_abstract: 在患者接受检测之后，ClinVar中的基因变异经常被重新分类，有时从意义未明变为致病，然而对患者的再联系并不一致，既无明确的义务，责任也分散于实验室、医疗提供者和患者之间。许多受影响的人在公共在线健康社区中讨论其检测结果，而临床再联系往往无法触达这些社区。我们构建了PRISM，一个基于智能体的大语言模型流程，它筛查这些帖子，检查该变异后来是否被重新分类，并在不实际联系的演练（dry run）中起草附带免责声明的外联信息。在来自32个社区的390万条帖子中，智能体预测的与重新解读相关的讨论很少见（0.288%），但集中于专业遗传学社区（6.30%，而一般医疗咨询社区为0.10%），且自2014年以来增长了五倍；PRISM发现了123项候选分类差异，其中5项是从意义未明的提交变为致病或可能致病。在一组30份真实帖子草稿的留出集上，一名临床医生判定27份事实依据充分，15份适合发送：事实准确性对于临床上可接受的外联而言是必要的，但并不充分。PRISM提供了一幅人群规模的重新解读需求图谱，代码和数据将在发表时公开。

title: CardioLM: A multilingual suite of small language models for the cardiology domain
zh_title: CardioLM：心脏病学多语言小型语言模型套件
summary: 构建含七种语言的心脏病病例报告语料CardioCCC，并发布CardioBERTa编码器及NER模型。
key_points: 508篇西班牙语病例扩展至七种语言
经机器翻译、标注投射与临床医生审核
含继续预训练编码器与微调NER模型
reason: 新多语言专科语料与模型，预印本，规模有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Cardiovascular care generates large volumes of clinical free-text documentation in local languages. However, clinical natural language processing (NLP) resources remain concentrated in English, and no existing benchmark is cardiology-specific, multilingual, and broad in entity coverage. Methods: We present two contributions. The first is CardioCCC, a corpus of 508 cardiology case reports originally published in Spanish and extended to Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, and Swedish through machine translation, annotation projection, and clinician review, with annotations covering diseases, symptoms, procedures, and medications. The second is CardioLM, comprising CardioBERTa, a set of language-specific encoders obtained by continued pretraining on cardiology and biomedical corpora, and CardioNER, a set of named entity recognition (NER) models fine-tuned on CardioCCC. Results: Cardiology-specific pretraining reduced pseudo-perplexity by up to a factor of eight, yet changed strict span-level F1 by at most 0.04, with benefits concentrated in languages whose backbones lacked biomedical coverage. The jointly trained multilingual XLM-RoBERTa-large models achieved the best strict F1 in nearly every language and entity type, exceeding the strongest monolingual system by up to 0.13 F1. A large share of residual errors concerned boundary detection: relaxed matching recovered 0.10-0.23 F1 for disease, procedure, and symptom, but only 0.01-0.07 for medication. Clinicians rated CardioNER well above a rule- and dictionary-based baseline, with the mean rating across entity types rising from 26% to 73%. Conclusions: Specialty-specific pretraining is not the decisive factor for downstream entity recognition, whereas multilingual joint training yields the strongest results in nearly all settings and a simpler deployment path for multi-country clinical information extraction.

title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
zh_title: TACT-KV：医学VLM中体数据KV缓存的三轴余弦变换压缩
summary: 提出免校准的3D DCT方法，压缩3D CT/MRI视觉语言模型的KV缓存以缓解显存瓶颈。
key_points: 利用三个解剖轴上的空间相关性
可分离3D离散余弦变换
按频率分量分配逐层比特预算
reason: 医学VLM的新颖效率方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.

title: Computation, not weight access: large language models as auditors of clinical prediction networks
zh_title: 计算而非权重访问：大语言模型作为临床预测网络审计者
summary: 在模拟蛛网膜下腔出血队列中，比较大模型直接读取权重与借助计算工具审计小型临床预测网络的能力。
key_points: 网络含105至38,401个权重
设置无工具、白盒与黑盒条件
含植入关系与漏报死亡标签场景
reason: 设计清晰的预印本方法评估，但仅为模拟数据，属值得一看档
abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) have been reported to read, edit and write the weights of small neural networks, raising the prospect of auditing clinical prediction models from their files alone. Public demonstrations, however, mixed reading raw weights with running code. We separated these conditions in internally pre-specified simulation experiments. Tanh networks of 105 to 38,401 weights were trained on simulated cohorts of patients with subarachnoid haemorrhage, each with a planted relationship or none, and one network was trained on labels that under-recorded deaths in a subgroup. GPT-6 Astra and four other GPT models answered single prompts under a default or an explicit system instruction, either with the weights in the prompt and no tools, or with a calculation-only tool that exposed the weights (white box) or only the network's predictions (black box). Without tools, Astra recovered planted relationships in 353-weight networks but became unreliable at 3,457 weights, and under the default instruction it declined 11 of 12 audit and repair tasks as unidentifiable; the explicit instruction removed these refusals. With the tool, it recovered the planted relationship in all 29 runs on networks of up to 38,401 weights, raised no false alarm in 15 runs on null networks, and found the biased subgroup in 6 of 6 runs. Black-box access performed as well as white-box access, and other GPT-6 models read as accurately. A well-designed script matched the comparator models on the audit and the best LLM repair. For auditing these networks, what mattered was computation and elicitation, not access to the weights.
zh_abstract: 据报道，前沿大语言模型（LLM）能够读取、编辑并写入小型神经网络的权重，这使得仅凭文件即可审计临床预测模型成为可能。然而，公开演示将读取原始权重与运行代码混在了一起。我们在内部预先设定的模拟实验中将这两种条件分开。我们在蛛网膜下腔出血患者的模拟队列上训练了含105至38,401个权重的tanh网络，每个队列要么植入了某种关系，要么没有；另有一个网络是在某亚组死亡记录不足的标签上训练的。GPT-6 Astra及其他四个GPT模型在默认或明确的系统指令下回答单次提示，条件为：权重置于提示中且无工具；或使用仅限计算的工具，该工具暴露权重（白盒），或仅暴露网络的预测（黑盒）。在无工具时，Astra能在353个权重的网络中还原植入的关系，但在3,457个权重时变得不可靠；在默认指令下，它以“无法识别”为由拒绝了12项审计与修复任务中的11项；明确指令消除了这些拒绝。使用工具时，它在最多含38,401个权重的网络上的全部29次运行中还原了植入的关系，在零假设网络的15次运行中未产生假警报，并在6次运行中6次发现了有偏差的亚组。黑盒访问的表现与白盒访问相当，其他GPT-6模型的读取同样准确。一个设计良好的脚本在审计方面与对照模型相当，在修复方面与最佳LLM相当。对于这些网络的审计而言，重要的是计算和引导（elicitation），而不是对权重的访问。

title: When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization
zh_title: 验证不等于一致：跨智能体LLM到Dafny的形式化
summary: 提出跨智能体协议，将临床试验标准转为Dafny谓词，并在96份试验文档上评估不同模型配置的一致性。
key_points: 同模型重新提取一致性仅59.3%
角色分配显著影响一致性
测试四种模型配置
reason: 涉及试验标准形式化的新方法预印本，样本有限，属值得一看档
abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.
zh_abstract: 经过验证的 Dafny 后置条件可证明某个公式成立，但并不能保证结果是通过真正独立的推理得到的。我们提出一种跨智能体形式化协议：由 Specifier 模型将临床试验标准翻译为 Dafny 谓词，由 Implementer 模型编写依据该谓词检验的可操作方法。同模型对照表明，即使不存在能力差距，对相同文本独立重新提取的一致率也仅为 59.3%。我们在 96 份临床试验文档上评估了四种模型配置，发现一致率对模型能力在两个角色间如何分配高度敏感：GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini 配置在较强模型担任 Implementer 时一致率为 53.0%，而角色对调后仅为 14.3%。测试中最强的配置 GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini 将一致率提高到 34.4%，但仍低于同模型基线，且以直接矛盾为主（42.7%）。我们还发现一种关键的验证伪影：较弱的 Implementer 通过直接调用 Specifier 的谓词来满足后置条件；经结构审计后，校正后的一致率由 14.3% 降至 13.2%。我们的结果表明，仅有验证成功不足以证明跨智能体的独立一致，并且在对同一来源独立进行形式化时，模型能力并不能保证一致。

title: Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives
zh_title: 面向病理档案的可扩展诊断驱动全切片图像检索
summary: 提出CLEAR-WSI，用定长切片嵌入进行全切片图像检索，并在公开与临床数据上验证。
key_points: 定长切片嵌入
面向病理档案可扩展检索
公开与临床数据验证
reason: 病理检索新方法预印本，验证细节有限，属值得一看档
abstract: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. Using a fixed-length slide embedding, CLEAR-WSI refines retrieved candidates with either a predicted diagnostic label or the ground-truth label, depending on the retrieval setting. Newly processed cases are subsequently added to the expanding memory bank, allowing the retrieval archive to grow over time. On a comprehensive benchmark consisting of two public and one private clinical datasets representing four retrieval tasks, CLEAR-WSI improves Precision@5 over the strongest evaluated baseline, with gains on CAMELYON16 (3.10), BRACS-1 (2.75), BRACS-2 (1.95), and X-HER2 (3.75). Additional ablation and latency studies further examine the contribution of each component and highlight its potential for scalable deployment.
zh_abstract: 数字病理的日益普及使苏木精-伊红全切片图像的收藏迅速扩大，但由于元数据常常不一致或缺失，在这些档案中高效检索仍具挑战。基于内容的图像检索通过直接依据视觉表征而非人工标注或元数据来识别相似病例，从而应对这一挑战。现有检索系统已展现出良好性能，但在很大程度上依赖手工设计的索引流程和预定义的采样策略，限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。在此，我们提出 CLEAR-WSI（Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images），这是一种可扩展的、以诊断为驱动的切片检索框架，并在公开数据和临床数据上均得到验证。CLEAR-WSI 采用定长切片嵌入，并根据检索设置，使用预测的诊断标签或真实标签对检索到的候选结果进行优化。新处理的病例随后被加入不断扩充的记忆库，使检索档案可随时间增长。在由两个公开数据集和一个私有临床数据集构成、涵盖四项检索任务的综合基准上，CLEAR-WSI 相比评估的最强基线提高了 Precision@5，其中 CAMELYON16 提高 3.10，BRACS-1 提高 2.75，BRACS-2 提高 1.95，X-HER2 提高 3.75。进一步的消融和延迟研究考察了各组成部分的贡献，并凸显了其可扩展部署的潜力。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Cardiovascular Health Behavior Change: A Narrative Review of Patient-Facing Tools.
source: PubMed · Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education
zh_title: 面向心血管健康行为改变的AI患者工具叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述检索10个数据库，纳入19项研究，评价对应LE8框架的患者端AI工具的效果与公平性。
key_points: 纳入19项实证研究，其中5项为随机对照试验
聚焦心血管健康教育与行为改变
关注效果与公平性
reason: 叙述性综述，纳入研究少，属增量档
abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death in the United States and disproportionately affects racial/ethnic minoritized populations, low-income communities, older adults, and rural residents. Behavioral interventions can reduce cardiovascular risk, yet traditional programs face scalability barriers, including high costs and limited reach. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on the efficacy and equity of patient-directed AI tools that support health education and behavior change for cardiovascular health. Using PRISMA-ScR elements, we searched 10 databases (January 2010 to December 2025), yielding 19 empirical studies evaluating Generation 2.0 AI systems aligned with the American Heart Association's Life's Essential 8 (LE8) framework. Of these, five were randomized controlled trials (RCTs), and 14 were nonrandomized (quasi-experimental, observational, or early-stage) studies. AI-enabled interventions such as conversational agents, machine-learning models, and reinforcement-learning systems addressed hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, and related conditions. Among the RCTs, one demonstrated superiority of an AI-powered program over usual care (AI-delivered Diabetes Prevention Program), whereas the remaining four reported outcomes equivalent or non-inferior to standard behavioral care. Effects were most apparent in high-intensity interventions that paired machine learning-based personalization with structured behavioral curricula, although the multi-component nature of these programs limits inference about AI-specific contributions. Across nonrandomized studies, greater engagement intensity was consistently associated with improved cardiometabolic outcomes, although causal attribution to AI-specific mechanisms remains limited. Most studies had small samples, short follow-up, and limited reporting on safety and equity. Technology-intensive interventions were concentrated in higher-resourced settings, and populations with limited health literacy showed reduced engagement. Overall, evidence supports cautious optimism that AI can meaningfully scale personalized cardiovascular prevention; however, realizing that equitable and clinically meaningful impact will require rigorous trials with longer follow-up, explicit behavioral science integration, safety-conscious governance, and equity-centered strategies addressing digital determinants of health.
zh_abstract: [Health education & behavior：公共卫生教育学会官方出版物] 心血管疾病（CVD）是美国的首要死因，对少数族裔、低收入社区、老年人和农村居民的影响尤为严重。行为干预可降低心血管风险，但传统项目面临可扩展性障碍，包括成本高和覆盖范围有限。本叙述性综述综合了关于面向患者的 AI 工具在支持心血管健康的健康教育和行为改变方面的有效性与公平性的证据。我们采用 PRISMA-ScR 的要素，检索了 10 个数据库（2010 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月），共纳入 19 项评估与美国心脏协会“生命基本8要素”（Life's Essential 8，LE8）框架相一致的第 2.0 代 AI 系统的实证研究。其中 5 项为随机对照试验（RCT），14 项为非随机研究（准实验、观察性或早期研究）。对话式智能体、机器学习模型和强化学习系统等 AI 赋能干预针对高血压、糖尿病、心力衰竭及相关疾病。在 RCT 中，1 项显示 AI 驱动的项目优于常规照护（AI 提供的糖尿病预防项目），其余 4 项报告的结局与标准行为照护相当或不劣于后者。效果在将基于机器学习的个性化与结构化行为课程相结合的高强度干预中最为明显，但这些项目的多组分性质限制了对 AI 特定贡献的推断。在非随机研究中，更高的参与强度始终与心脏代谢结局的改善相关，但将其因果归因于 AI 特定机制的证据仍然有限。大多数研究样本量小、随访时间短，且在安全性和公平性方面的报告有限。技术密集型干预集中在资源较充足的环境中，健康素养有限的人群参与度较低。总体而言，证据支持对 AI 能够有意义地扩大个性化心血管预防规模持谨慎乐观态度；然而，要实现这种公平且具有临床意义的影响，需要开展随访时间更长的严格试验、明确整合行为科学、实施注重安全的治理，并采取以公平为中心、应对健康数字决定因素的策略。

title: Contextual Semantic Pattern Recognition for Mental Health Monitoring Using ClinicalBERT Transformers.
zh_title: 基于ClinicalBERT的心理健康监测语义模式识别
summary: 将结构化心理健康记录转为文本描述后输入ClinicalBERT，并与RF、XGBoost、BERT、TabTransformer等对比。

对比多种传统与表格Transformer基线

abstract: [Brain and behavior] This study aimed to develop an interpretable ClinicalBERT-based framework for mental health monitoring using structured clinical data. Because the Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring dataset contains structured patient attributes rather than free-text clinical narratives, a structured-to-text transformation module was used to convert the records into contextual descriptions suitable for ClinicalBERT. The proposed model was compared with Random Forest, XGBoost, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), TabTransformer, and a Deep Neural Network, and to strengthen the experimental comparison, contemporary tabular transformer models, including SAINT and FT-Transformer, were also evaluated. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Cross-validation, confidence interval analysis, statistical significance testing, and ablation experiments were conducted to examine the reliability of the results. SHAP and LIME were used to explain global feature contributions and individual predictions. ClinicalBERT achieved an accuracy of 90.2%, a precision of 90.5%, a recall of 90.4%, and an F1-score of 90.6%, outperforming all comparison models. The additional validation analyses supported the stability of the results. SHAP and LIME further identified the patient attributes that contributed most strongly to the model's predictions. The findings indicate that structured clinical records can be transformed into contextual representations for transformer-based mental health monitoring. The framework combines predictive performance with interpretable output, although its evaluation is currently limited to a single dataset. Further validation using multi-institutional and prospective data is required.
zh_abstract: 【脑与行为】本研究旨在利用结构化临床数据，开发一种基于 ClinicalBERT 的可解释心理健康监测框架。由于“心理健康诊断与治疗监测”（Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring）数据集包含的是结构化的患者属性，而非自由文本的临床叙述，因此采用了结构化到文本的转换模块，将这些记录转换为适合 ClinicalBERT 的上下文描述。将所提出的模型与随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost、双向编码器表示（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers，BERT）、TabTransformer 和深度神经网络（Deep Neural Network）进行比较；为加强实验对比，还评估了当代表格型 Transformer 模型，包括 SAINT 和 FT-Transformer。采用准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数评估模型性能。通过交叉验证、置信区间分析、统计显著性检验和消融实验来检验结果的可靠性。使用 SHAP 和 LIME 解释全局特征贡献和个体预测。ClinicalBERT 的准确率为 90.2%，精确率为 90.5%，召回率为 90.4%，F1 分数为 90.6%，优于所有对比模型。额外的验证分析支持了结果的稳定性。SHAP 和 LIME 进一步识别出对模型预测贡献最大的患者属性。研究结果表明，结构化临床记录可以转换为上下文表示，用于基于 Transformer 的心理健康监测。该框架兼具预测性能与可解释的输出，但目前其评估仅限于单一数据集。尚需利用多机构和前瞻性数据进行进一步验证。

title: Wearable Arrhythmia Detection: Moving from your Watch to your Shirt?
zh_title: 可穿戴心律失常检测：从手表到衬衫？
summary: 综述总结可穿戴设备筛查与诊断房颤的现有证据，AI 辅助自动节律分析；单导联心电设备证据最强，存在运动伪影等局限。

智能手表是研究最广泛的可穿戴设备

abstract: [Current cardiology reports] Digital devices play an increasingly important role in the detection and screening of cardiac arrhythmias. Atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common arrhythmia, is associated with an increased risk of stroke, heart failure, and mortality. This review summarises the current evidence on wearable devices for screening and diagnosing atrial fibrillation. Numerous studies have demonstrated the value of wearables for AF detection and diagnosis. In addition, artificial intelligence enhances automated rhythm analysis and signal processing, supporting the increasing clinical implementation of digital technologies in outpatient care. Single-lead ECG devices provide the strongest evidence for AF detection, with smartwatches representing one of the most extensively investigated wearable technology. Limitations include motion artefacts and predominantly semi-continuous monitoring. Future research should focus on integrating artificial intelligence to improve signal analysis and artefact reduction, and on evaluating the impact of wearable-based strategies on clinically relevant outcomes, including stroke and heart failure.
zh_abstract: 【当前心脏病学报告】数字设备在心律失常的检测和筛查中发挥着越来越重要的作用。心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，与卒中、心力衰竭和死亡风险增加相关。本综述总结了关于可穿戴设备用于筛查和诊断心房颤动的现有证据。大量研究已证明可穿戴设备在 AF 检测和诊断中的价值。此外，人工智能增强了自动化节律分析和信号处理，支持数字技术在门诊医疗中日益广泛的临床应用。单导联心电图设备为 AF 检测提供了最有力的证据，其中智能手表是研究最为广泛的可穿戴技术之一。其局限性包括运动伪影以及监测主要为半连续性。未来研究应着重于整合人工智能以改进信号分析和减少伪影，并评估基于可穿戴设备的策略对包括卒中和心力衰竭在内的临床相关结局的影响。

title: Artificial intelligence for predicting mutation effects on enzyme kinetics.
source: PubMed · Current opinion in structural biology

summary: 综述预测突变对酶催化周转（kcat）影响的AI方法，包括机器学习势能模拟、监督模型和生成序列模型。

abstract: [Current opinion in structural biology] Predicting how mutations affect enzyme kinetics, especially catalytic turnover (kcat), remains a major challenge in enzymology. Reliable predictions could help identify promising variants early and reduce experimental screening in enzyme-engineering campaigns. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are expanding the tools available to address this challenge. Current AI approaches include molecular simulations using machine learning potentials, supervised models trained on experimental kinetics data, and generative sequence models that rank mutation effects. This review summarizes recent progress, remaining limitations, and opportunities for improving kinetic prediction, with an emphasis on studies that evaluate multiple variants and systematically assess the relationship between computational predictions and experimental measurements.

title: Balancing innovation and ethics: responsible governance of artificial intelligence hallucinations in healthcare.
source: PubMed · Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM
zh_title: 平衡创新与伦理：医疗AI幻觉的负责任治理
summary: 论文基于生物医学伦理四原则，分析医疗生成式AI幻觉的伦理风险，并引入负责任研究与创新（RRI）框架提出治理思路。
key_points: 识别四条风险路径：知情同意、信任、健康损害、责任分配
使用生物医学伦理四原则分析
引入RRI构建多维治理框架
reason: 伦理治理类观点文章，常规增量档
abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare and may improve efficiency in clinical support, health management, and doctor-patient communication. Yet its tendency to hallucinate, that is, to generate medical information that appears plausible but is false, can create systemic ethical risks in high-risk medical settings. This paper addresses two questions: what distinctive ethical risks are created by medical AI hallucinations, and what governance mechanisms can respond to them? Using the four principles of biomedical ethics as an analytical tool, the paper identifies four risk pathways: weakened informed consent, erosion of doctor-patient trust, harm to life and health, and unfair responsibility allocation. It then introduces responsible research and innovation (RRI) to build a four-dimensional framework of anticipation, inclusion, reflexivity, and responsiveness. The main contribution of the paper is to integrate biomedical ethical principles with RRI governance tools in the specific context of medical AI hallucinations, developing a closed-loop governance matrix across technology development, clinical application, and regulatory oversight. This provides an operational pathway for moving medical AI from technical feasibility towards ethical trustworthiness.
zh_abstract: [医学中的哲学、伦理与人文 : PEHM] 生成式人工智能（AI）在医疗领域的应用日益增多，可能提高临床支持、健康管理及医患沟通的效率。然而，其产生幻觉的倾向，即生成看似合理但实为虚假的医学信息，可能在高风险医疗场景中造成系统性伦理风险。本文探讨两个问题：医疗AI幻觉会带来哪些独特的伦理风险，以及何种治理机制可以应对这些风险？本文以生物医学伦理四原则为分析工具，识别出四条风险路径：知情同意被削弱、医患信任受到侵蚀、对生命健康造成损害，以及责任分配不公。随后引入负责任研究与创新（RRI），构建包含预期、包容、反思和响应的四维框架。本文的主要贡献在于，在医疗AI幻觉这一特定情境下，将生物医学伦理原则与RRI治理工具相结合，形成贯穿技术开发、临床应用和监管监督的闭环治理矩阵。这为推动医疗AI从技术可行走向伦理可信提供了一条可操作的路径。

source: PubMed · The Australasian journal of dermatology

abstract: [The Australasian journal of dermatology] The smartphone has become dermatology's primary clinical camera, yet the photo it saves is assembled by software rather than being a faithful unedited photograph: several frames are merged, grain is removed, and texture is altered before the image file exists, so no unedited original survives. This processing is hidden, inconsistent between shots, recorded only in undocumented vendor-specific form, and cannot be fully disabled in the camera app. Smartphone photographs still serve to locate a lesion and support a referral, but the processing pipeline is ill-suited and potentially misleading for serial monitoring, research, and training of artificial intelligence models. We propose a per-image record of capture and processing, practical measures clinicians can take now, and smartphone camera processing pipelines built for clinical fidelity rather than aesthetic ends.
zh_abstract: [澳大拉西亚皮肤病学杂志] 智能手机已成为皮肤科主要的临床摄影设备，但其保存的照片是由软件合成的，而非忠实的、未经编辑的照片：在图像文件生成之前，已将多帧图像合并、去除噪点并改变纹理，因此不存在未经编辑的原始图像。这种处理是隐蔽的，各次拍摄之间不一致，仅以未公开记录的、厂商特定的形式记录，并且无法在相机应用中完全关闭。智能手机照片仍可用于定位病变和支持转诊，但其处理流程并不适合用于连续监测、研究以及人工智能模型的训练，并可能造成误导。我们提出了针对每张图像的拍摄与处理记录、临床医生目前即可采取的实用措施，以及以临床保真度而非美学目的为导向设计的智能手机相机处理流程。

title: Spatially and Compositionally Controlled Multimodal Glioblastoma MRI Synthesis with Latent Diffusion
zh_title: 潜在扩散模型实现空间与成分可控的胶质母细胞瘤多模态MRI合成
summary: 提出两阶段潜在扩散框架，先生成可控肿瘤分割图，再用ControlNet生成T1、T1Gd、T2、FLAIR图像。
key_points: 分割LDM按位置、范围、轴向位置和亚区成分生成肿瘤图
ControlNet使合并FID由42.59降至36.12
