abstract: Glioblastoma exhibits substantial heterogeneity in tumour morphology and composition across MRI modalities, often making available clinical datasets highly unbalanced in terms of patient pathologies. We propose a two-stage latent diffusion model (LDM) framework for the generation of explicitly controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans. First, a segmentation LDM generates tumour maps conditioned on location, spatial extent, axial position, and subregion composition. Second, a modality-conditioned LDM with ControlNet generates T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR images adhering to the requested segmentation. On a held-out test set, generated segmentations achieved a mean centroid error of 0.842 pixels and a subregion proportion error of 0.795 percentage points. ControlNet improved Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, reducing pooled FID from 42.59 to 36.12. An expert reader study yielded mean quality ratings of 6.60 for real images, 6.83 for ControlNet-generated images, and 6.77 for fully synthetic images.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤在不同 MRI 模态上的肿瘤形态和组成表现出显著异质性，常使现有临床数据集在患者病理方面高度不平衡。我们提出一种两阶段潜在扩散模型（LDM）框架，用于生成可明确控制的二维胶质母细胞瘤 MRI 扫描。第一阶段，分割 LDM 以位置、空间范围、轴向位置和亚区组成为条件生成肿瘤图。第二阶段，带有 ControlNet 的模态条件 LDM 生成符合所要求分割的 T1、T1Gd、T2 和 FLAIR 图像。在留出的测试集上，生成的分割结果平均质心误差为 0.842 像素，亚区比例误差为 0.795 个百分点。ControlNet 改善了所有四种模态的 Fréchet inception distance（FID），使合并 FID 从 42.59 降至 36.12。一项专家阅片研究得到的平均质量评分为：真实图像 6.60，ControlNet 生成图像 6.83，完全合成图像 6.77。

title: LungMend: A Healthy-Only Latent Diffusion Shape Prior for Lung Mask Correction in Severe Tuberculosis CT

summary: 用仅在健康肺上训练的潜在扩散模型，后处理修正R231在重症结核CT中遗漏空洞和实变的肺掩膜。

abstract: Lung segmentation models such as R231 are widely used, but they fail on severe tuberculosis (TB) CT: cavities and consolidations look like non-lung tissue and are left out of the mask. We present LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects such masks using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion model, trained on healthy lungs with synthetically corrupted masks, learns to recover the complete lung from the faulty mask and the bone anatomy, without any pathological data or CT intensities. LungMend recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 misses and improves accuracy on expert-annotated slices. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend
zh_abstract: R231 等肺分割模型被广泛使用，但在重症结核病（TB）CT 上表现不佳：空洞和实变看起来像非肺组织，被排除在掩膜之外。我们提出 LungMend，这是一种仅利用健康解剖结构来纠正此类掩膜的后处理模型。一个潜在扩散模型在健康肺及经合成破坏的掩膜上训练，学习根据有缺陷的掩膜和骨骼解剖结构恢复完整的肺，无需任何病理数据或 CT 强度信息。LungMend 能恢复 R231 遗漏的空洞和实变，并提高专家标注切片上的准确性。代码：https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend

title: Multi-objective domain adaptation for pan-cancer transfer of pharmacogenomic drug response to patient tumours
zh_title: MODAE+：泛癌药物反应从细胞系迁移至患者肿瘤
summary: 提出多目标域适应深度学习框架MODAE+，联合对齐、去混杂、药物反应、生存及癌种分类，将细胞系药敏迁移到患者肿瘤。
key_points: 同时优化域对齐与去混杂等五类目标
使用TCGA肿瘤及细胞系数据训练
旨在缓解跨域分布偏移

abstract: Large-scale pharmacogenomic screens provide rich drug-sensitivity measurements in cancer cell lines, but transferring these measurements to patient tumours remains limited by biological heterogeneity and cross-domain distribution shift. Existing machine learning approaches, including adversarial autoencoder and domain adaptation, address this gap by learning shared latent representations between preclinical models and patient samples. However, alignment without explicit biological constraints can produce unreliable representations when cancer lineage structure and clinically relevant patient heterogeneity are not preserved. Here, we introduce MODAE+, a pan-cancer multi-objective deep learning domain adaptation framework that jointly balances domain alignment, deconfounding, drug-response prediction, survival prediction, and cancer-lineage classification across 9,696 TCGA tumours, 1,293 CCLE cancer cell lines, and CTRP sensitivity profiles for 544 compounds in 738 matched cell lines. This multi-objective design improved cross-domain alignment while preserving cancer-lineage organization and patient heterogeneity. For drugs shared between the pharmacogenomic screen and TCGA treatment records, MODAE+ predicted sensitivity was significantly associated with overall survival among patients who received each drug in 46.3% of evaluated cancer-drug pairs by log-rank testing and 41.5% by multivariable Cox analysis. Biological validation across four curated drug-gene resources identified significant expression differences exceeding 1.5-fold for 34.9-64.4% of drugs in pan-cancer analyses, based on the lowest-p-value annotated gene per drug. Drug-class-specific patterns involved intended molecular targets for targeted therapies and predominantly transport, metabolism, detoxification and resistance-related genes for classical chemotherapies. As an additional validation, we derived pretreatment responder-nonresponder gene-expression signatures from 13 external breast cancer datasets and evaluated their concordance with MODAE+ predictions across 69 signature-drug comparisons in TCGA patients treated with paclitaxel or doxorubicin. title: First-trimester nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling during home sleep testing and later pregnancy complications: a secondary analysis of the nuMoM2b cohort
zh_title: 孕早期夜间心肺耦合与后续妊娠并发症：nuMoM2b队列二次分析
summary: 预印本分析2504名初产妇家庭睡眠监测，考察孕早期心肺耦合特征与妊娠糖尿病、子痫前期、早产和巨大儿的关系。
key_points: 纳入nuMoM2b队列2504名孕妇
用双变量相位校正信号平均量化耦合
同时建模四种妊娠并发症
reason: 较大队列的睡眠生理信号研究，预印本且为二次分析
abstract: We tested whether direction-specific nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling (CRC) in the first trimester differed in pregnancies that later developed obstetric complications. The analysis included 2504 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort with valid level 3 home sleep recordings at 6-13 weeks' gestation. Bidirectional CRC between RR intervals and abdominal respiratory effort was quantified using bivariate phase-rectified signal averaging in consecutive 5-min segments. Coupling strength, local transition dynamics, and waveform irregularity were summarized by nightly mean and standard deviation. Associations with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM; n = 111), preeclampsia (n = 149), preterm birth (n = 192), and fetal macrosomia (n = 186) were examined using proportional-odds models with CRC feature quintile as the ordered outcome. Models included all four complications simultaneously and adjusted for maternal age, pre-pregnancy body mass index, race and ethnicity, gestational age at recording, relevant medical and family history, medication use, and apnea-hypopnea index >5 events/h. Holm correction was applied across outcomes. GDM was associated with lower respiration-to-heart rate coupling strength (cumulative odds ratio, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.31-0.64; P < 0.001) and shallower slope at the anchor point (0.63; 0.45-0.89; P = 0.03). Fetal macrosomia was associated with lower within-night variability in heart rate-to-respiration waveform irregularity (0.59; 0.45-0.77; P < 0.001). No associations with preeclampsia or preterm birth remained significant after correction. Direction-specific differences in nocturnal CRC were detectable in the first trimester in pregnancies that later developed GDM or resulted in fetal macrosomia.
zh_abstract: 我们检验了孕早期特定方向的夜间心肺耦合（CRC）在后来发生产科并发症的妊娠中是否存在差异。分析纳入 nuMoM2b 队列中 2504 名初产妇，她们在妊娠 6-13 周时有有效的 3 级家庭睡眠记录。采用双变量相位校正信号平均法，在连续 5 分钟的时间段内量化 RR 间期与腹部呼吸努力之间的双向 CRC。耦合强度、局部转换动力学和波形不规则性以夜间均值和标准差进行汇总。采用比例优势模型，以 CRC 特征五分位数作为有序结局，考察其与妊娠期糖尿病（GDM；n = 111）、子痫前期（n = 149）、早产（n = 192）和胎儿巨大儿（n = 186）的关联。模型同时纳入全部四种并发症，并对产妇年龄、孕前体重指数、种族和民族、记录时的孕周、相关医疗史和家族史、用药情况以及呼吸暂停低通气指数 >5 次/小时进行了校正。对各结局采用 Holm 校正。GDM 与较低的呼吸至心率耦合强度（累积比值比 0.45；95% CI，0.31-0.64；P < 0.001）以及锚点处较平缓的斜率（0.63；0.45-0.89；P = 0.03）相关。胎儿巨大儿与心率至呼吸波形不规则性的夜内变异性较低相关（0.59；0.45-0.77；P < 0.001）。校正后，子痫前期和早产均未发现仍具显著性的关联。在后来发生 GDM 或导致胎儿巨大儿的妊娠中，孕早期即可检测到夜间 CRC 的方向特异性差异。

title: A protein language model for domain, functional site, and variant effect prediction
zh_title: 面向结构域、功能位点与变异效应预测的蛋白质语言模型
summary: 预印本提出PALM，在ESM2上结合LoRA等模块，联合预测蛋白结构域与功能位点，并用于变异效应预测。
key_points: 训练于约1500万InterPro标注序列
保留重叠与嵌套注释的软目标
230万留出蛋白上域/位点F1为0.941/0.877
reason: 规模较大的蛋白语言模型预印本，有留出评估，缺外部验证细节
abstract: Protein sequence databases are growing far faster than experimentally curated annotations, limiting functional interpretation of newly identified proteins and coding variants. We developed PALM, a protein annotation language model that jointly predicts domain and functional-site occurrence, while preserving overlapping and nested annotations through a soft-target objective. PALM integrates ESM2 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), learned layer aggregation, and a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) encoder. PALM was trained on ~15 million InterPro-annotated UniRef50 sequences spanning 17,951 domain and 1,383 site classes. Across 2.3 million held-out proteins, PALM achieved domain- and site-occurrence F1 scores of 0.941 and 0.877, respectively, and retained substantial performance in proteins with <20% sequence identity to the training and validation data. PALM also substantially outperformed ESM3 annotation baseline. Without training on variant-pathogenicity labels, PALM embedding disruption distinguished 151,823 ClinVar missense variants more accurately than ESM2 embedding disruption (AUROC 0.835 versus 0.710), and combining PALM embedding disruption with the ESM2 likelihood-ratio signal reached an AUROC of 0.877. The same combined zero-shot score outperformed AlphaMissense on a benchmark dataset on 128,161 missense variants, that were derived from literature but not present in ClinVar database. At the protein level, PALM embeddings showed stronger CATH-Gene3D superfamily organization than frozen ESM2 and ESM3 embeddings, and improved prediction of experimental activation and repression effects when combined with ESM2. In a downstream case study, we demonstrated the ability to use PALM-derived embedding as proxy of deep mutational scanning (DMS), showcasing the broad application of PALM. Together, PALM converts curated residue-level knowledge into transferable and mechanistically interpretable representations that connect protein sequence, function, and variant consequence.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质序列数据库的增长速度远快于经实验验证的注释，限制了对新鉴定蛋白质和编码变异的功能解读。我们开发了 PALM（蛋白质注释语言模型，protein annotation language model），它能联合预测结构域和功能位点的出现，并通过软目标目标函数保留重叠和嵌套的注释。PALM 将 ESM2 与低秩适应（LoRA）、可学习的层聚合以及双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）编码器整合在一起。PALM 在约 1500 万条带有 InterPro 注释的 UniRef50 序列上训练，涵盖 17,951 个结构域类别和 1,383 个位点类别。在 230 万条留出的蛋白质中，PALM 的结构域出现和位点出现 F1 分数分别为 0.941 和 0.877，并且在与训练和验证数据序列相似度 <20% 的蛋白质中仍保持相当的性能。PALM 也明显优于 ESM3 注释基线。在未使用变异致病性标签训练的情况下，PALM 嵌入扰动区分 151,823 个 ClinVar 错义变异的准确度高于 ESM2 嵌入扰动（AUROC 0.835 对 0.710），将 PALM 嵌入扰动与 ESM2 似然比信号结合后 AUROC 达到 0.877。在一个包含 128,161 个错义变异、来源于文献但不在 ClinVar 数据库中的基准数据集上，同一组合零样本评分优于 AlphaMissense。在蛋白质层面，PALM 嵌入比冻结的 ESM2 和 ESM3 嵌入表现出更强的 CATH-Gene3D 超家族组织性，并且与 ESM2 结合后可改善对实验激活和抑制效应的预测。在一项下游案例研究中，我们展示了将 PALM 衍生嵌入用作深度突变扫描（DMS）代理的能力，体现了 PALM 的广泛应用。总之，PALM 将经整理的残基水平知识转化为可迁移且机制上可解释的表征，将蛋白质序列、功能和变异后果联系起来。

title: FeatureMAP enables network-guided interpretation of untargeted metabolomics
zh_title: FeatureMAP：网络引导的非靶向代谢组学解读
summary: 预印本提出FeatureMAP框架，整合代谢物注释、网络精修、模块发现及基于大模型的功能解读。
key_points: 在十个公开数据集上改进MS1候选代谢物优先排序
半合成基准中模拟扰动恢复率达92%
引入结构化大语言模型进行功能解读
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Untargeted liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) metabolomics generates thousands of features, but incomplete metabolite annotation and reliance on predefined pathways limit their biological interpretation. Here we present FeatureMAP, an LC-MS feature-centric computational framework that integrates multi-evidence metabolite annotation, network-guided refinement, metabolic module discovery, and structured large language model-based functional interpretation. Across ten public datasets, FeatureMAP improved MS1-based metabolite candidate prioritization while reducing annotation redundancy. In semi-synthetic benchmarks, FeatureMAP recovered coordinated metabolic perturbations, achieving 92% recovery of a simulated perturbation, and distinguished concurrent metabolic processes. Controlled benchmarks further evaluated functional interpretation under competing metabolite-level signals. Based on FeatureMAP, we additionally developed PhenoMAP, a phenotype-aware knowledge graph comprising 12,929 dysregulated metabolic modules from 501 human metabolomics studies spanning 326 phenotypes. Module-level comparisons revealed reproducible metabolic similarities across independent studies and biologically supported relationships among phenotypes. Application to Alzheimer's disease cerebrospinal fluid and cellular datasets identified convergent membrane-lipid alterations and implicated galactose-linked glycosphingolipid remodeling. Together, FeatureMAP and PhenoMAP enable network-grounded interpretation of incompletely annotated LC-MS metabolomics data and systematic investigation of metabolic dysregulation across biological conditions.
zh_abstract: 非靶向液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）代谢组学可产生数千个特征，但代谢物注释不完整以及对预定义通路的依赖限制了其生物学解释。在此我们提出 FeatureMAP，一种以 LC-MS 特征为中心的计算框架，整合了多证据代谢物注释、网络引导的优化、代谢模块发现以及基于大语言模型的结构化功能解释。在十个公共数据集中，FeatureMAP 改善了基于 MS1 的代谢物候选优先排序，同时减少了注释冗余。在半合成基准测试中，FeatureMAP 恢复了协同的代谢扰动，对模拟扰动的恢复率达 92%，并能区分同时发生的代谢过程。受控基准测试进一步评估了在相互竞争的代谢物水平信号下的功能解释。在 FeatureMAP 的基础上，我们还开发了 PhenoMAP，这是一个表型感知知识图谱，包含来自 501 项人类代谢组学研究、涵盖 326 种表型的 12,929 个失调代谢模块。模块水平的比较揭示了独立研究之间可重复的代谢相似性，以及表型之间有生物学依据支持的关系。将其应用于阿尔茨海默病脑脊液和细胞数据集，发现了趋同的膜脂改变，并提示与半乳糖相关的糖鞘脂重塑有关。总之，FeatureMAP 和 PhenoMAP 能够对注释不完整的 LC-MS 代谢组学数据进行基于网络的解释，并可系统研究不同生物学条件下的代谢失调。

title: Language-guided domain adaptation improves protein sequence rep-resentations for antimicrobial resistance analysis
zh_title: 语言引导的领域适应改进抗菌素耐药性蛋白序列表示
summary: 提出BacLLM，将UniProt注释知识通过跨模态对比学习注入蛋白语言模型，用于WHO重点病原菌的耐药基因识别与机制预测。
key_points: 融合注释语义与序列编码器
跨模态对比学习迁移LLM先验
用于耐药基因识别与机制预测
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR), particularly antibiotic resistance in bacterial pathogens, complicates infectious disease management. Because bacterial resistance is often mediated by protein functions, including antibiotic inactivation and efflux, protein sequence analysis provides a molecular basis for digital AMR surveillance and therapeutic intervention. We developed BacLLM, a language guided protein representation framework that integrates annotation-derived functional knowledge into protein language model representations for AMR analysis in WHO priority bacterial pathogens. Through sequence enhancement, semantic enrichment of UniProt annotations, and cross modal contrastive learning, BacLLM transfers LLM encoded annotation priors into the sequence encoder. Compared with baselines, BacLLM provided more informative representations for resistance-gene identification and mechanism prediction, captured resistance associated mutational signals at single-residue resolution, and preserved taxonomic relationships not reflected by phenotype based clinical groupings. Moreover, BacLLM recovered resistance associated functional organization within a TolC-centered protein association network, prioritizing proteins with low sequence identity to TolC but predicted structural similarity to TolC. Extending from AMR characterization to therapeutic prioritization, BacLLM also improved strain-level phage host matching for phage therapy candidate prioritization. Together, these findings establish BacLLM as a protein representation framework supporting AMR surveillance, functional characterization, and therapeutic candidate prioritization.

title: Classifying tumors from broad category to hierarchical molecular subtype: an interpretable hierarchical framework for precision oncology
zh_title: 层级可解释框架：从大类到分子亚型的泛癌分类
summary: 预印本提出基于癌症Hallmark的层级递归模型HHRM，在26种原发癌、11,476例样本上进行泛癌层级多标签分类，强调可解释性。
key_points: 层级标签结构结合递归神经网络
覆盖26种原发癌及405个亚型
面向精准肿瘤学并强调可解释
reason: 样本量较大的新方法预印本，但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Precise tumor subtype classification is important for guiding personalized treatment, characterizing tumor heterogeneity, and investigating molecular mechanisms. However, most existing multi-label classification models use flat architectures and do not fully exploit the inherent hierarchical relationships and biological constraints among tumor types, which limits their performance and interpretability in complex, fine-grained pan-cancer classification. Here, we present the cancer Hallmark-based Hierarchical Recursive Model (HHRM) for pan-cancer hierarchical multi-label classification. HHRM integrates hierarchical label structures with recursive neural networks, enabling simultaneous modeling of multi-level dependencies from broad cancer categories to specific subtypes. We trained the model on a comprehensive pan-cancer cohort of 11,476 samples spanning 26 primary cancer types and 405 subtypes across up to eight hierarchical levels. HHRM achieved an accuracy of 0.7924 for predicting hierarchical tumor subtypes and was further evaluated on a validation dataset of 887 samples. Compared with other hierarchical modeling frameworks, HHRM achieved higher accuracy in all three output modes. Ablation experiments showed that replacing the hallmark-based graph convolutional network reduced model performance. On an independent dataset of 1,608 breast cancer samples, HHRM also achieved an accuracy greater than 0.86. Finally, we combined SHAP with a network-based method to rank and analyze predictive genes at different levels of the tumor hierarchy, which identified both known and potentially novel biomarkers for cancer diagnosis. In conclusion, to our knowledge, HHRM is the first hierarchical model for multi-level tumor subtype classification. Its competitive performance, combined with post hoc biological interpretation, suggests potential value for precision cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 精确的肿瘤亚型分类对于指导个体化治疗、刻画肿瘤异质性和研究分子机制具有重要意义。然而，现有的大多数多标签分类模型采用扁平结构，未能充分利用肿瘤类型之间固有的层级关系和生物学约束，限制了其在复杂、细粒度泛癌分类中的性能和可解释性。在此，我们提出了基于癌症特征（Hallmark）的层级递归模型（HHRM），用于泛癌层级多标签分类。HHRM将层级标签结构与递归神经网络相结合，能够同时建模从广泛的癌症类别到具体亚型的多层级依赖关系。我们在一个全面的泛癌队列上训练该模型，该队列包含11,476个样本，涵盖26种原发癌类型和405个亚型，层级最多达八级。HHRM在预测层级肿瘤亚型时的准确率为0.7924，并在包含887个样本的验证数据集上进一步评估。与其他层级建模框架相比，HHRM在三种输出模式下均取得了更高的准确率。消融实验表明，替换基于特征（hallmark）的图卷积网络会降低模型性能。在包含1,608个乳腺癌样本的独立数据集上，HHRM的准确率也超过0.86。最后，我们将SHAP与基于网络的方法相结合，对肿瘤层级中不同层次的预测基因进行排序和分析，识别出了已知的以及潜在的新型癌症诊断生物标志物。总之，据我们所知，HHRM是首个用于多层级肿瘤亚型分类的层级模型。其具有竞争力的性能，加上事后的生物学解释，提示其在精准癌症诊断中具有潜在价值。

title: Therapeutic Functions in Large Language Model Responses to Emotional Disclosures: Qualitative Content Analysis.
zh_title: 大模型回应情绪倾诉的治疗功能：定性内容分析
summary: 用54条模拟情绪倾诉输入测试前沿大模型的回应，考察其是否在功能上类似促进自我觉察的治疗实践。
key_points: 54条模拟输入，变化长度与表达风格
输入由三种大模型生成
关注回应与治疗实践的相似性
reason: 小规模模拟输入定性分析，无真实用户，属增量档
abstract: [JMIR formative research] Millions of people now use general-purpose large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet how these models respond to emotional disclosures and whether their responses functionally resemble established therapeutic practices remain uncharacterized. This study aimed to characterize how frontier LLMs respond to emotionally charged messages and examine whether their response patterns resemble therapeutic practices associated with self-awareness. We generated 54 simulated user inputs representing mild-to-moderate everyday emotional difficulties. These simulated user inputs were generated using 3 LLMs (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 2.5 Pro). The simulated user inputs systematically varied across 3 lengths and 5 communicative registers, ranging from raw venting to pragmatic requests. Then, each simulated user input was presented as a standalone user turn to the same 3 frontier LLMs, yielding 162 responses. Two independent clinical coders qualitatively coded the resulting responses using an inductive approach. The codes were compared and consolidated through iterative consensus, which yielded 8 higher-order categories. Acknowledging and validating segments appeared in 89.5% (145/162) of responses, emotion-focused suggestions in 84.6% (137/162), and interpretation in 67.3% (109/162). These patterns converged on emotional self-awareness, a construct associated with adaptive emotion regulation, suggesting that LLMs may repeatedly enact a recognizable micro-process of validation, affect labeling, interpretation, reflection, and regulation support. Models differed in stance, with some assigning emotional labels and interpretations directly rather than prompting users' own reflection. Frontier LLMs respond to emotional disclosures in patterned, largely convergent ways that approximate therapeutic techniques for building emotional awareness, though delivered more didactically than in clinical practice. Whether these responses build genuine self-awareness, reduce symptoms, or provide therapeutic benefit requires controlled and naturalistic investigation.

abstract: [Obstetrical & gynecological survey] Digital transformation has fundamentally reshaped obstetrics and gynecology (OB/GYN). abstract: [Health policy (Amsterdam, Netherlands)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in health care to improve the quality of care, support clinical decision-making, and increase efficiency. As AI systems are integrated into healthcare workflows, they can also become involved in how work is managed, including directing tasks, coordinating workflows, monitoring activity, and evaluating performance. These managerial uses of digital and AI systems are commonly referred to as forms of algorithmic management. Such uses may contribute to the intended benefits of AI, but may also make work more standardised, measurable, and monitorable, potentially increasing managerial control, reducing professional autonomy, or intensifying work. Whether these consequences arise depends on how these systems are implemented and governed. Realising AI's potential in health care therefore requires explicit choices about how AI is used within healthcare organisations and how gains from automation are allocated, so that benefits for care are maximised while potential harms are limited.

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundMedical image segmentation is a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning, and its research landscape has expanded rapidly with the advancement of artificial intelligence. A systematic bibliometric overview of this field is therefore needed to clarify its intellectual structure and emerging trends.ObjectiveTo provide a comprehensive bibliometric overview of the global research landscape, developmental trends, collaboration networks, and emerging hotspots in the field of medical image segmentation over the past decade.MethodsA bibliometric analysis was performed on 21,437 publications related to medical image segmentation, indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection from 2016 to 2025. The analysis systematically examined publication outputs, country-level contributions, author collaboration networks, journal distributions, and keyword co-occurrence patterns.ResultsThe annual publication count increased remarkably from 25 in 2016 to 5,207 in 2025. China contributed the largest share with 11,556 publications, followed by the United States (3,272) and India (1,924). Core researchers formed stable intra-team collaborations, though inter-team cooperation remained limited. Keyword and citation analyses identified deep learning, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformers, U-Net, and their variants as dominant methodological themes. Case studies on skin and lung segmentation revealed differential research attention and international collaboration patterns across anatomical targets. A historical trajectory analysis showed methodological evolution from traditional image processing to fully convolutional networks and U-Net, and subsequently to hybrid architectures integrating attention mechanisms and Transformers.ConclusionMedical image segmentation has experienced substantial growth, driven by deep learning innovations. Future research may increasingly focus on multimodal foundation models capable of generalizable segmentation across diverse clinical scenarios. This bibliometric review offers researchers a valuable reference for understanding the intellectual structure and frontiers of the field.

abstract: [JACC. Case reports] Implantable loop recorders (ILRs) are often implanted to investigate unexplained syncopal episodes. However, ILRs may produce false alerts due to undersensing or artifacts, thus requiring careful review of numerous device recordings, which makes it challenging to identify clinically significant events. abstract: Objective: To develop the Cardiologist Annotation Tool (CAT) for frame-level cardiac view and image-quality annotation in fetal echocardiography and compare it with spreadsheet-based annotation. Methods: CAT provides cine playback, frame navigation, and keyboard-based labeling without manual frame-range entry. Experts annotated 25 studies using both methods, and spreadsheet annotations were audited for predefined data-entry errors. In a randomized crossover study, six medical students annotated two normal studies, one with each method, against an expert reference. Results: Among 1,746 spreadsheet-annotated files, 6.2% contained major or critical data-entry errors, more frequently in congenital heart disease than normal studies (10.9% vs 3.4%). CAT yielded more annotated view segments per clip (3.6 vs 1.5). Rates of labeled and correctly labeled frames per minute were 1.77 and 1.68 times those with spreadsheets, respectively (both P = 0.031), with gains in all six students. No detectable difference in view-label accuracy was observed. Conclusion: CAT eliminates manual frame-range entry and enables finer-grained, structured annotation of fetal echocardiography, providing a practical approach to preparing datasets for AI research.

abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.

title: Finite Element Elastographic Analysis of Kidney MRI for Computational Assessment of Chronic Kidney Disease
zh_title: 基于有限元弹性成像的肾脏MRI慢性肾病计算评估
summary: 提出基于有限元的计算弹性成像框架，从常规肾脏MRI估计生物力学参数，并评估其区分慢性肾病与健康对照的能力。
key_points: 肾脏分割转为有限元网格
Kelvin-Voigt粘弹性模型与亥姆霍兹反演
区分CKD与健康对照

abstract: Background and Objective: Bridging kidney MRI with patient-specific computational biomechanics may enable accurate, noninvasive assessment of chronic kidney disease. To develop a finite element method (FEM)-based computational elastography framework for estimating renal biomechanical properties from conventional kidney MRI and to evaluate its ability to differentiate chronic kidney disease (CKD) from healthy controls. Methods: Kidney segmentation masks from healthy control and CKD subjects were converted into triangulated surface meshes, and watertight surfaces were tetrahedralized to create volumetric FEM meshes. Kidney tissue was modeled as a nearly incompressible Kelvin-Voigt viscoelastic material. Harmonic wave propagation simulations were performed using FEM, followed by Helmholtz-based elastographic inversion to estimate complex shear modulus distributions. Derived biomechanical parameters were used for CKD classification using machine learning models. Results: FEM-derived stiffness estimates showed consistency with stiffness ranges previously reported in human renal MRE studies and also showed measurable differences between healthy and CKD groups. Machine learning models trained on FEM-derived features achieved classification performance up to 86.26% cross-validation accuracy with an AUC of 0.92. Conclusion: FEM-derived elastographic parameters showed potential for distinguishing CKD from healthy tissue and may provide an alternative for renal biomechanical assessment without dedicated MRE acquisition.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】将肾脏MRI与患者特异性计算生物力学相结合，可能实现对慢性肾脏病的准确、无创评估。本研究旨在开发一种基于有限元法（FEM）的计算弹性成像框架，用于从常规肾脏MRI估计肾脏生物力学特性，并评估其区分慢性肾脏病（CKD）与健康对照的能力。【方法】将健康对照和CKD受试者的肾脏分割掩模转换为三角形表面网格，并将封闭（watertight）表面四面体化，以生成体积FEM网格。肾组织被建模为近不可压缩的Kelvin-Voigt粘弹性材料。采用FEM进行谐波传播模拟，随后进行基于Helmholtz方程的弹性成像反演，以估计复剪切模量分布。所得生物力学参数用于通过机器学习模型进行CKD分类。【结果】FEM得出的硬度估计值与既往人体肾脏MRE研究报告的硬度范围一致，并且在健康组与CKD组之间显示出可测量的差异。基于FEM衍生特征训练的机器学习模型，交叉验证准确率最高达86.26%，AUC为0.92。【结论】FEM衍生的弹性成像参数显示出区分CKD与健康组织的潜力，可能为无需专用MRE采集的肾脏生物力学评估提供一种替代方法。

title: Shaping & Monitoring Models through their Internal Representations
zh_title: 通过内部表征塑造与监控模型
summary: 提出Mechanistic Shaping框架，在训练中依据内部表征约束模型所表达和依赖的概念，覆盖视觉、医学影像与语言任务，并探讨被塑造概念的可监控性。
key_points: 统一框架，覆盖分类、SFT、DPO、GRPO
规模最高达32B参数，含医学影像场景

abstract: We propose Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework for shaping models through their internal representations. Mechanistic Shaping is applied during training so that models follow specifications (rules) about which concepts they express, measured via their outputs or internal representations (e.g., no harmful content), and also which concepts they rely on, i.e., what they use to make their decisions (e.g., not a candidate's gender when screening a résumé). Across multiple domains (vision, medical imaging, language), scales (up to 32B parameters), and training paradigms (classification, SFT, DPO, GRPO), we find that Mechanistic Shaping substantially reduces targeted behaviors while preserving task performance. Since training against a representation can also modify it, we ask whether shaped concepts remain monitorable, a question that depends on the class of monitors considered. We therefore introduce a hierarchy of such classes, which separates a concept that escapes one probe from a concept that is truly gone. We characterize three geometric mechanisms of circumvention: the concept can drift away from the monitor, be erased from the layer, or persist in higher-order statistics as a nonlinear encoding, which we explain through a product-code construction. Although other mechanisms may arise in different settings or at larger scales, these three account for all of our observations, and each can be detected by a matching monitor. In practice, we find that shaped concepts largely remain monitorable: refitted linear probes recover the concept in most settings, and the original probe remains reliable whenever gradients do not flow through it. Taken together, these results point to the potential of using interpretability as a tool for training, and call for a correspondingly rigorous science of interpretability-based training.
zh_abstract: 我们提出“机制塑形”（Mechanistic Shaping），这是一个通过模型内部表征来塑形模型的统一框架。机制塑形在训练过程中应用，使模型遵循关于其表达哪些概念（通过其输出或内部表征来衡量，例如不含有害内容）以及依赖哪些概念（即做出决策时所使用的依据，例如筛选简历时不依赖候选人的性别）的规范（规则）。在多个领域（视觉、医学影像、语言）、多种规模（最高达 32B 参数）和多种训练范式（分类、SFT、DPO、GRPO）中，我们发现机制塑形在保持任务性能的同时，显著减少了目标行为。由于针对某一表征进行训练也可能改变该表征，我们提出这样的问题：被塑形的概念是否仍可被监测？这一问题取决于所考虑的监测器类别。为此，我们引入了一个此类监测器类别的层级体系，用以区分“概念仅仅逃脱了某一个探针”与“概念确实已不复存在”。我们刻画了三种规避的几何机制：概念可能偏离监测器，可能从该层中被抹除，或者以非线性编码的形式保留在高阶统计量中，我们通过乘积码（product-code）构造对此加以解释。尽管在不同设置或更大规模下可能出现其他机制，但这三种机制可以解释我们所有的观察结果，并且每一种都可以被相应的监测器检测到。在实践中，我们发现被塑形的概念在很大程度上仍然可被监测：重新拟合的线性探针在大多数设置中都能恢复该概念，且只要梯度不经过原始探针，原始探针就仍然可靠。综上所述，这些结果表明将可解释性用作训练工具具有潜力，并呼吁建立一门相应严谨的、基于可解释性的训练科学。

title: OcTreeMamba: Topology-Aware Mamba for 3D Medical Segmentation via Octree Sparsification
zh_title: OcTreeMamba：基于八叉树稀疏化的拓扑感知3D医学分割
summary: 提出将八叉树结构引入Mamba状态空间模型的3D医学分割框架，通过可微分的解剖区域选择实现拓扑感知的长程上下文传播。
key_points: Structure Learner用门控与Gumbel-Softmax选择区域
利用3D解剖结构的稀疏性降低冗余
面向3D医学图像分割
reason: 新分割架构，摘要未见外部验证，预印本
abstract: Accurate segmentation of 3D anatomical structures is crucial to medical image analysis. Recently, Mamba-based approaches have achieved promising segmentation performance in capturing long-range dependencies with linear-time computational complexity. However, heuristic selective scanning strategies inherently disrupt the intrinsic spatial hierarchy and increase computational redundancy, ignoring the inherent sparsity of 3D anatomical structures. To this end, we propose OcTreeMamba, a hierarchical framework that incorporates Octree structures into SSM, achieving 3D topology-aware long-range context feature propagation and integration. Specifically, a Structure Learner performs anatomy-adaptive structured sparsification through hierarchical gating and Gumbel-Softmax sampling, enabling differentiable selection of anatomical regions. The selected regions are subsequently organized by a Dynamic Octree Builder into a multi-level topology that preserves their hierarchical connectivity. Based on the constructed Octree, a bidirectional Tree-SSM propagates and integrates contextual features along connectivity-aware leaf--parent--root and root--parent--leaf trajectories. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that our proposed OcTreeMamba achieves competitive performance \wrt topological continuity and computational efficiency, particularly for recovering the complex structure on vascular datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/MikeMak123/OcTreeMamba.
zh_abstract: 3D 解剖结构的准确分割对医学图像分析至关重要。近来，基于 Mamba 的方法以线性时间计算复杂度捕获长程依赖，取得了有前景的分割性能。然而，启发式的选择性扫描策略本质上会破坏固有的空间层级结构并增加计算冗余，忽视了 3D 解剖结构固有的稀疏性。为此，我们提出 OcTreeMamba，一种将八叉树（Octree）结构融入状态空间模型（SSM）的层级框架，实现感知 3D 拓扑的长程上下文特征传播与整合。具体而言，结构学习器（Structure Learner）通过层级门控和 Gumbel-Softmax 采样进行解剖自适应的结构化稀疏化，从而实现对解剖区域的可微选择。随后，动态八叉树构建器（Dynamic Octree Builder）将所选区域组织成保持其层级连通性的多层级拓扑。基于所构建的八叉树，双向 Tree-SSM 沿着感知连通性的叶—父—根以及根—父—叶路径传播并整合上下文特征。在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们提出的 OcTreeMamba 在拓扑连续性和计算效率方面取得了有竞争力的性能，尤其是在血管数据集上恢复复杂结构方面。代码可在 https://github.com/MikeMak123/OcTreeMamba 获取。

title: TRiST: Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer for Medical Image Analysis
zh_title: TRiST：拓扑增强的Swin Transformer用于医学图像分析
summary: 提出在Swin各阶段融合持续同调拓扑信息的医学图像分析框架，包含多尺度拓扑表示、残差精炼与注意力集成模块。
key_points: 在四个Swin阶段分别计算H0/H1持续同调
按持续性长短分别用门控残差网络处理
将拓扑信息用于特征构建、精炼和注意力
reason: 方法有新意，摘要未见结果与外部验证，预印本
abstract: Medical images contain topological patterns, such as connected components and loops, at scales ranging from small lesions to organ boundaries. Although hierarchical Vision Transformers have advanced medical image analysis, they do not explicitly incorporate topology throughout their multiscale representations. We propose Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer (TRiST), a framework that integrates topological information into feature construction, refinement, and attention. First, a Hierarchical Multi-Scale Topology Representation algorithm computes 2D persistent homology (H0 and H1) independently at four native Swin stages, producing descriptors aligned with each stage's token grid rather than downsampling fine-scale topology. Second, a Band-Aware H0/H1 Residual Refinement module uses gated residual networks to process short-, medium-, and long-persistence information separately. Third, a Persistence-Band Progressive Attention Bias converts stage-specific descriptors into learned key-saliency scores that directly modify shifted-window attention logits. We instantiate TRiST as Topo-SwinV2-B for classification and Topo-Swin-UNet for segmentation, preserving the underlying Swin-based backbones. Experiments on five medical image datasets show consistent improvements over Swin-based baselines and competitive performance relative to existing topology-augmented methods.
zh_abstract: 医学图像中包含拓扑模式，例如连通分量和环，其尺度范围从小病灶到器官边界。尽管层级式视觉 Transformer 推动了医学图像分析的发展，但它们并未在其多尺度表征中显式地纳入拓扑信息。我们提出拓扑强化 Swin Transformer（Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer，TRiST），这是一个将拓扑信息整合到特征构建、精炼和注意力中的框架。首先，层级多尺度拓扑表示算法在 Swin 的四个原生阶段上分别独立计算 2D 持续同调（H0 和 H1），生成与各阶段 token 网格对齐的描述符，而不是对精细尺度拓扑进行下采样。其次，带感知 H0/H1 残差精炼（Band-Aware H0/H1 Residual Refinement）模块使用门控残差网络分别处理短、中、长持续性信息。第三，持续性带渐进注意力偏置（Persistence-Band Progressive Attention Bias）将各阶段特定的描述符转换为学习得到的关键显著性分数，直接修改移位窗口注意力的 logits。我们将 TRiST 实例化为用于分类的 Topo-SwinV2-B 和用于分割的 Topo-Swin-UNet，同时保留其基础的 Swin 主干网络。在五个医学图像数据集上的实验表明，相比基于 Swin 的基线方法取得了一致的改进，并且相对于现有的拓扑增强方法具有有竞争力的性能。

abstract: [Bioethics] In this paper, we argue for the adoption of algorithmic bioethics, which uses algorithms, in the form of decision trees, to articulate, understand, apply, and evaluate bioethical arguments. Algorithms bring many benefits to the study of bioethics: they clearly, precisely, and transparently articulate the decision procedure and facts relevant to an ethical decision; furthermore, they can be used to systematically discover, map out, and compare different ethical decision procedures concerning a practical issue. We then also outline and tackle potential limitations of algorithmic bioethics, and explore future directions for using decision trees in bioethics. Throughout, we illustrate our points using a case study of ethical decision trees, created with the help of large language models, about conscientious objection in medicine.

title: LTVAE: Hybrid LSTM-Transformer VAE Architecture for Molecular SMILES Representation.

abstract: [Journal of computational chemistry] A hybrid LSTM-Transformer Variational Autoencoder (LTVAE) framework is introduced in this paper for learning compact and chemically meaningful latent representations from SMILES strings, providing a SMILES-to-latent-to-SMILES representation model trained on ZINC15 and evaluated on ZINC15 and an out-of-distribution dye dataset. In the proposed model, sequential and structural dependencies in molecular strings are encoded using a bidirectional LSTM, while a Transformer-based decoder is employed to reconstruct valid molecular structures in the evaluated settings. When trained on a curated ZINC15 dataset, the framework achieves reasonable reconstruction performance, with 98.58% token-level accuracy, 92.19% string-level accuracy, a 99.30% chemical validity ratio, and an average Levenshtein distance of 0.29 using a 64-dimensional latent space. Reconstruction under an out-of-distribution evaluation setting is evaluated on a structurally distinct dye dataset, where 95.56% token-level accuracy and 85.30% validity are achieved. The learned latent space preserves trends aligned with both general molecular descriptors and dye-relevant structural descriptors, particularly conjugation length and aromatic surface fraction, with Fsp 3 providing complementary information on molecular saturation. Controlled perturbations in the latent space suggest smooth and chemically consistent structural variations, illustrating the continuity and interpretability of the learned latent manifold.
zh_abstract: [Journal of computational chemistry] 本文提出一种混合 LSTM-Transformer 变分自编码器（LTVAE）框架，用于从 SMILES 字符串中学习紧凑且具有化学意义的潜在表示，构建了“SMILES→潜在空间→SMILES”的表示模型，在 ZINC15 上训练，并在 ZINC15 及一个分布外染料数据集上进行评估。在所提出的模型中，使用双向 LSTM 对分子字符串中的序列依赖和结构依赖进行编码，同时采用基于 Transformer 的解码器，在所评估的设置中重建有效的分子结构。在经整理的 ZINC15 数据集上训练时，该框架在 64 维潜在空间下取得了较为合理的重建性能：词元（token）级准确率为 98.58%，字符串级准确率为 92.19%，化学有效率为 99.30%，平均 Levenshtein 距离为 0.29。在分布外评估设置下，于结构上差异明显的染料数据集上评估重建性能，词元级准确率为 95.56%，有效率为 85.30%。所学习到的潜在空间保留了与通用分子描述符和染料相关结构描述符均一致的变化趋势，尤其是共轭长度和芳香表面积分数，而 Fsp 3 则为分子饱和度提供了补充信息。对潜在空间进行的受控扰动提示，结构变化平滑且在化学上具有一致性，体现了所学潜在流形的连续性和可解释性。

title: AI-enhanced biosensing for antimicrobial resistance: translating rapid diagnostics to global surveillance.
zh_title: AI增强生物传感用于抗菌素耐药：从快速诊断到全球监测
summary: 综述AI与微流控、电化学/光学生物传感及CRISPR技术结合，用于抗菌素耐药快速检测，涵盖信号处理与预测解读。

AI用于降噪、模式识别与多重检测

abstract: [Biomedical microdevices] Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) necessitates rapid and reliable diagnostic technologies to support timely antimicrobial selection and stewardship. Although conventional culture-based antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) remains clinically important, its extended turnaround time limits timely intervention, while molecular diagnostics can rapidly identify resistance determinants but may not accurately predict phenotypic resistance. This review critically examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with biomedical microdevices and biosensors for rapid AMR detection, encompassing microfluidic and lab-on-chip platforms, electrochemical and optical biosensors, and CRISPR-based technologies. Emphasis is placed on the application of AI for signal processing, noise reduction, pattern recognition, multiplexed detection, and predictive interpretation of complex biosensor outputs. Key translational challenges, including biofouling, matrix interference, sample-preparation variability, bubble formation, evaporation, signal drift, invalid-test rates, device reproducibility, and inadequate standardisation of reporting and validation, are critically evaluated. The requirements for embedded AI, including memory, computational resources, latency, and energy efficiency, are also considered for portable point-of-care deployment. Analytical, clinical, and operational validation are distinguished, with emphasis on prospective multicentre evaluation using representative specimens and reference AST methods. Beyond clinical diagnosis, AI-enabled microdevices offer potential for decentralised AMR surveillance across wastewater, agricultural, veterinary, and environmental settings within a One Health framework. Translation will require standardised datasets, generalisable and explainable AI, scalable manufacturing, regulatory oversight, data governance, and equitable deployment. Overall, AI-integrated biomedical microdevices represent a promising approach to rapid, decentralised, and actionable AMR diagnostics and surveillance, contingent on robust real-world validation.
zh_abstract: [生物医学微型器件] 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）亟需快速、可靠的诊断技术，以支持及时的抗菌药物选择和合理使用管理。尽管传统的基于培养的药敏试验（AST）在临床上仍然重要，但其周转时间较长，限制了及时干预；而分子诊断虽可快速识别耐药决定因素，却未必能准确预测表型耐药。本综述批判性地审视了人工智能（AI）与生物医学微型器件及生物传感器相结合用于快速检测AMR的情况，涵盖微流控和芯片实验室平台、电化学和光学生物传感器以及基于CRISPR的技术。重点关注AI在信号处理、降噪、模式识别、多重检测以及对复杂生物传感器输出进行预测性解读方面的应用。文中批判性地评估了关键的转化挑战，包括生物污损、基质干扰、样本制备差异、气泡形成、蒸发、信号漂移、无效检测率、器件重复性，以及报告和验证标准化不足。同时还考虑了便携式即时检测（point-of-care）部署中嵌入式AI对内存、计算资源、延迟和能效的要求。文章区分了分析验证、临床验证和操作验证，并强调应使用具有代表性的标本和参考AST方法开展前瞻性多中心评估。除临床诊断外，AI赋能的微型器件还有潜力在“同一健康”（One Health）框架下，用于污水、农业、兽医和环境场景中的去中心化AMR监测。转化应用需要标准化数据集、可泛化且可解释的AI、可规模化的生产、监管监督、数据治理以及公平部署。总体而言，集成AI的生物医学微型器件是实现快速、去中心化且可付诸行动的AMR诊断与监测的一种有前景的方法，但取决于稳健的真实世界验证。

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
zh_title: 医疗AI数学基础的系统综述
summary: 依据PRISMA对2016至2026年文献检索，653条记录中纳入147项研究，梳理医疗AI的数学基础。

纳入147项研究，用VOSviewer做文献计量

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 医疗人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍较为零散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗 AI 的经典和新兴数学基础，并考察了主要的方法学和应用趋势。遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，通过系统检索 Scopus、Google Scholar 和 PubMed/MEDLINE 识别 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月 30 日发表的研究，适用时使用 Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 进行检索。使用 VOSviewer 进行文献计量分析，并采用改编的基于 JBI 的框架评估方法学质量，系统综述则采用 AMSTAR-2。在识别出的 653 条记录中，147 项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码显示，线性代数见于 100/147 项研究（68.0%），微积分与优化见于 91/147（61.9%），概率与统计见于 79/147（53.7%），突出了它们在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。另一项对主导方法学主题的互斥分类显示，可解释和可信 AI 见于 24/147 项研究（16.3%），统计与学习理论 23/147（15.6%），概率与贝叶斯方法 23/147（15.6%），微积分与优化 19/147（12.9%），线性代数 15/147（10.2%）。放射学和医学影像是主要的医疗应用领域（24.3%），而分类和诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗 AI 由一个相互关联的数学生态系统所支撑。包括图神经网络、Transformer 和量子机器学习在内的新兴方法，需要更强的外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，才能实现可靠的临床转化。

title: Vibrational spectroscopy and artificial intelligence for dynamic phenotypic characterization of antimicrobial resistance.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology

summary: 综述振动光谱结合机器学习/AI，用于快速细菌分类、耐药预测及耐药表型表征的潜力。

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] The rapid emergence of antimicrobial resistance has created an urgent need for diagnostic technologies capable of rapidly identifying resistant phenotypes and informing precision antimicrobial therapy. Conventional antimicrobial susceptibility testing methods remain clinically reliable; however, they are limited by relatively long turnaround times and restricted physiological resolution. In recent years, vibrational spectroscopy techniques have emerged as promising platforms for rapid phenotypic microbiology because they generate label-free biochemical fingerprints associated with proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and membrane biomolecules. When integrated with machine learning and artificial intelligence, these technologies could provide highly sensitive tools for rapid bacterial classification, resistance prediction, and monitoring of dynamic physiological adaptation during antibiotic exposure. This review discusses the integration of chemometrics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms with spectroscopic datasets, emphasizing both predictive performance and biological interpretability. It is highly useful for bacterial identification, biochemical characterization, and resistance profiling across multiple microbial species. Major controversies regarding genotype-versus-phenotype diagnostics, reproducibility, standardization, and AI explainability are also examined. Finally, we highlight current research gaps and future directions, including single-cell spectroscopy, multimodal phenotyping, explainable AI frameworks, and approaches in systems microbiology. Taken together, the available evidence indicates that integrating vibrational spectroscopy with artificial intelligence could substantially reshape future antimicrobial resistance diagnostics and mechanistic microbiology.
zh_abstract: 抗微生物药物耐药性的迅速出现，使得对能够快速识别耐药表型并为精准抗微生物治疗提供依据的诊断技术产生了迫切需求。传统的抗微生物药物敏感性检测方法在临床上仍然可靠，但受限于周转时间相对较长和生理分辨率有限。近年来，振动光谱技术因能产生与蛋白质、脂质、核酸、碳水化合物和膜生物分子相关的无标记生化指纹，已成为快速表型微生物学中有前景的平台。当与机器学习和人工智能相结合时，这些技术可为快速细菌分类、耐药性预测以及监测抗生素暴露期间的动态生理适应提供高灵敏度的工具。本综述讨论了化学计量学、机器学习和深度学习算法与光谱数据集的整合，并强调预测性能和生物学可解释性。其对多种微生物物种的细菌鉴定、生化特征分析和耐药谱分析非常有用。文中还探讨了基因型与表型诊断、可重复性、标准化以及AI可解释性方面的主要争议。最后，我们指出了当前的研究空白和未来方向，包括单细胞光谱、多模态表型分析、可解释AI框架以及系统微生物学方法。综合来看，现有证据表明，将振动光谱与人工智能相结合可能会大幅重塑未来的抗微生物药物耐药性诊断和机制微生物学。

abstract: [Healthcare management forum] Telehealth is increasingly supported by connected devices, remote monitoring, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and distributed computing. These tools can extend access and support more responsive care, but their computational and environmental demands are rarely considered alongside clinical and organizational needs. We describe the current Canadian telehealth landscape, including remote care management, virtual visits, patient portals, and remote monitoring, and identify opportunities and gaps for AI integration. We then define Green AI in healthcare and explain how an IoT-fog-cloud architecture can support resource-aware telehealth. For health leaders, Green AI is not only an engineering issue. It affects procurement, infrastructure planning, workforce capacity, clinical workflow, environmental responsibility, and equity. Evaluation should consider clinical performance, resource use, organizational fit, and sustainability. Responsible AI-enabled telehealth requires more than technical performance. A Green AI perspective can help health organizations improve computational efficiency while maintaining patient safety, usable workflows, resilience, and equitable access.
zh_abstract: [医疗管理论坛] 远程医疗日益得到联网设备、远程监测、人工智能（AI）和分布式计算的支持。这些工具可以扩大医疗可及性并支持更及时响应的医疗服务，但其计算需求和环境需求很少与临床和组织需求一并考虑。我们描述了加拿大当前的远程医疗格局，包括远程医疗管理、虚拟问诊、患者门户和远程监测，并指出了AI整合方面的机遇与不足。随后，我们界定了医疗领域的绿色AI（Green AI），并阐释了物联网-雾-云（IoT-fog-cloud）架构如何支持具有资源意识的远程医疗。对于医疗卫生领导者而言，绿色AI不仅是工程问题，它还影响采购、基础设施规划、劳动力能力、临床工作流程、环境责任和公平性。评估应综合考虑临床性能、资源使用、与组织的契合度以及可持续性。负责任的AI赋能远程医疗所需要的不仅是技术性能。绿色AI视角可帮助医疗机构在保持患者安全、可用的工作流程、韧性和公平可及性的同时，提高计算效率。

title: From Vision to Context: A Review of Prompt-Driven Target Volume Segmentation in Radiotherapy

summary: 综述放疗靶区分割中的提示驱动方法，比较提示技术及其相对仅图像基线的表现与评估方式。

abstract: Accurate target volume (TV) segmentation is essential for radiotherapy (RT) planning but remains time-consuming. Moreover, the final contour depends on the expertise of the radiation oncologist. Although deep learning has improved medical image segmentation, image-only models cannot encode the clinical reasoning that governs TV delineation, particularly for the clinical target volume (CTV), where boundaries are defined by clinical knowledge rather than imaging features alone. Prompt-driven segmentation has recently emerged as a strategy to address this limitation. This work aims to review these approaches for RT TV segmentation with four objectives: (1) compare the different prompting techniques used; (2) compare their performance against image-only baselines; (3) assess how they are evaluated against standard metrics, including the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), 95th Hausdorff distance, sensitivity, precision, and clinical assessment; and (4) identify the gaps needed for clinical translation. We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and arXiv for studies incorporating geometric, clinical text, or interactive prompts into deep learning models for RT TV delineation. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning head and neck, breast, prostate, lung, cervix, and rectal cancers. Seven studies used clinical text prompting, four used geometric prompting, and two used interactive prompting; three combined modalities. Reported DSC ranged from 0.67 to 0.93, compared to 0.65 to 0.91 for image-only baselines. None reported sensitivity or precision. Clinical text prompting appears well suited to CTV delineation. Evidence remains limited, and standardized prompt engineering and clinical validation are needed before these approaches can be translated into routine RT practice.
zh_abstract: 准确的靶区（TV）分割对放射治疗（RT）计划至关重要，但仍然耗时。此外，最终轮廓取决于放射肿瘤医师的专业水平。尽管深度学习改进了医学图像分割，但仅基于图像的模型无法编码支配靶区勾画的临床推理，对于临床靶区（CTV）尤其如此，其边界由临床知识而非仅由影像特征界定。提示驱动的分割最近已成为解决这一局限的策略。本文旨在综述这些用于 RT 靶区分割的方法，有四个目标：(1) 比较所使用的不同提示技术；(2) 比较其与仅基于图像的基线的性能；(3) 评估其如何依据标准指标进行评价，包括 Dice 相似系数（DSC）、第 95 百分位 Hausdorff 距离、敏感性、精确率和临床评估；(4) 找出临床转化所需弥补的差距。我们系统检索了 PubMed、Embase 和 arXiv，纳入将几何提示、临床文本提示或交互式提示引入深度学习模型以进行 RT 靶区勾画的研究。13 项研究符合纳入标准，涵盖头颈部、乳腺、前列腺、肺、宫颈和直肠癌。7 项研究使用临床文本提示，4 项使用几何提示，2 项使用交互式提示；3 项结合了多种模式。报告的 DSC 范围为 0.67 至 0.93，而仅基于图像的基线为 0.65 至 0.91。没有研究报告敏感性或精确率。临床文本提示似乎很适合 CTV 勾画。目前证据仍然有限，在这些方法能够转化为常规 RT 实践之前，需要标准化的提示工程和临床验证。

abstract: Digital health may extend cardiovascular care in communities with limited specialist access, but its effectiveness depends on whether communities have the infrastructure, devices, affordability, and capacity needed to use digital services. We linked national data on cardiometabolic disease burden, cardiology workforce, and digital readiness across 82,999 US census tracts. Among high-burden tracts in counties with no cardiologist or declining per-capita cardiologist supply, 4,765 (18.0%) tracts representing 19.9 million residents had higher digital readiness and were thus classified as deployment-priority tracts, whereas 21,752 (82.0%) tracts representing 74.1 million residents had lower readiness and were investment-priority tracts. Investment-priority tracts were spread across the urban-rural continuum and faced different barriers (adoption versus infrastructure). Contrasting classifications frequently occurred among neighboring census tracts within the same metropolitan area, highlighting geographic variation not captured by county-level targeting. Findings were broadly consistent across nine additional analyses with varying measures of readiness, workforce access, and classification thresholds. These findings provide a national framework for distinguishing communities where digital cardiovascular care may be deployed from those where infrastructure and adoption support may first be needed to enable equitable implementation.
zh_abstract: 数字健康或许可以在专科医疗资源有限的社区中扩展心血管疾病的诊疗服务，但其成效取决于这些社区是否具备使用数字服务所需的基础设施、设备、可负担性和能力。我们将美国82,999个人口普查区（census tract）的心血管代谢疾病负担、心脏病专科医师人力和数字化准备度的全国性数据进行了关联。在没有心脏病专科医师或人均心脏病专科医师供给下降的县中，高负担普查区里，4,765个（18.0%）普查区（代表1,990万居民）的数字化准备度较高，因此被归类为优先部署（deployment-priority）普查区；而21,752个（82.0%）普查区（代表7,410万居民）的准备度较低，为优先投入（investment-priority）普查区。优先投入普查区分布于城乡连续体的各个层级，所面临的障碍也不同（采用障碍与基础设施障碍）。在同一都市区内，相邻普查区之间经常出现截然相反的分类结果，凸显了县级层面的目标定位所无法反映的地理差异。在另外九项采用不同准备度指标、人力可及性指标和分类阈值的分析中，结果大体一致。这些发现提供了一个全国性框架，用以区分哪些社区可以直接部署数字心血管诊疗，哪些社区则可能需要首先提供基础设施和采用方面的支持，以实现公平的实施。

abstract: Reconstructing participant-level data from published Kaplan-Meier curves supports meta-analysis and other secondary survival analyses when original trial records are unavailable. Researchers may use original PDF figures or screenshots, which can look alike but retain different information. We assessed how converting vector figures to images affects reconstruction by a language model that can inspect files and execute code. We generated 64 independent two-arm datasets across four scenarios combining 100 or 1,000 participants per arm with proportional or crossing hazards. Each figure was supplied as a native vector PDF and a matched 300-dpi PNG to Opus 5.5 through Claude Code under the same instructions. Outcomes compared reconstructed records with the original observed records: time-averaged absolute curve error through 24 months, error in the between-group restricted mean survival time difference, and error in the Cox log-hazard ratio. Native PDFs had lower curve error in all 64 completed pairs, including replacements for incomplete runs. Mean errors were 0.000029 and 0.1047 percentage points for PDF and PNG, respectively; the paired difference was -0.1047 (95% confidence interval, -0.1194 to -0.0909). PNG errors in the restricted mean survival time difference and log-hazard ratio were small: mean absolute errors were 0.0084 months and 0.0027. Lower resolution and compression increased curve errors; embedding unchanged pixels in a PDF did not restore vector accuracy. Some PNG runs exceeded the instructed revision limit, so results describe the implemented workflow rather than performance under a strictly enforced limit. Preserving vector information improved reconstruction fidelity in this workflow, but the observed differences do not establish clinically consequential changes in treatment estimates. Validation against reported survival summaries and event counts remains necessary. Generalization to published clinical figures and other model workflows requires further evaluation.

abstract: Background. Middle and external ear disease is common and largely treatable, but accurate otoscopic interpretation requires training that is scarce outside specialist ENT services. Published deep learning models for otoscopy report high accuracy, yet most are optimised for closed set classification rather than the referral decision a non specialist actually makes, report uncalibrated probabilities, and do not report the near duplicate controls that video derived otoscopic datasets demand. We developed, validated and deployed a screening aid framed around referral rather than diagnosis. Methods. We merged 4,763 otoscopic images from 16 folders across three public datasets into 12 clinically meaningful classes. Every image was passed through a single field of view normalisation function (crop to the illuminated field, square, resize to 224 px, mask to one fixed circle) shared identically by training and inference, to remove the framing cue that otherwise identifies the source dataset. Because one source is video derived, images were grouped by cosine similarity of generic ImageNet features (threshold 0.93, joined transitively) and whole groups assigned to a single split, giving 3,326 training, 719 validation and 718 test images. A MobileNetV2 backbone initialised from ImageNet was fine tuned from block9expand. Probabilities were averaged over the eight dihedral transforms of each image and temperature scaled. The referral score was one minus the probability of a normal ear, and its threshold was set on the validation abnormal ears as the highest value still meeting a target sensitivity of 97%, applied with an inclusive comparison. Model selection, calibration and threshold were frozen before the test split was scored once. Results. On the 718 held out test images, referral sensitivity was 97.0% (95% CI 95.1 to 98.2) and specificity 75.6% (95% CI 69.4 to 80.8), with AUROC 0.974 for abnormal versus normal; a cluster bootstrap over the 363 similarity groups in the test split widens those intervals to 93.8 99.6% and 66.0 83.4% respectively. Of 501 abnormal ears, 15 were not referred; 11 of these were myringosclerosis and none was cholesteatoma. Twelve class macro F1 was 0.686, balanced accuracy 68.3%, and accuracy 85.0% (86.2% with chronic subtypes merged). Temperature scaling (T = 1.2) reduced expected calibration error from 0.0498 to 0.0430. A low confidence flag fired on 4.0% of test images, separating 87.2% accuracy on unflagged from 31.0% on flagged cases.
zh_abstract:
【背景】中耳和外耳疾病常见且大多可治疗，但准确的耳镜判读需要培训，而在耳鼻喉专科服务之外这种培训十分稀缺。已发表的耳镜深度学习模型报告了较高的准确率，但大多针对封闭集分类进行优化，而非非专科人员实际做出的转诊决策，报告的概率未经校准，也未报告视频来源耳镜数据集所需的近重复对照。我们开发、验证并部署了一种以转诊而非诊断为框架的筛查辅助工具。
【方法】我们将来自三个公共数据集16个文件夹的4,763张耳镜图像合并为12个具有临床意义的类别。每张图像都经过一个在训练和推理中完全相同的视野归一化函数（裁剪至照明视野、方形化、调整为224像素、用一个固定圆形遮罩），以消除否则可识别数据集来源的取景线索。由于其中一个来源为视频来源，图像按通用ImageNet特征的余弦相似度分组（阈值0.93，传递性连接），并将整组分配至同一个数据划分，得到3,326张训练图像、719张验证图像和718张测试图像。以ImageNet初始化的MobileNetV2骨干网络从block9expand开始微调。概率在每张图像的八种二面体变换上取平均，并进行温度缩放。转诊评分为1减去正常耳的概率，其阈值在验证集异常耳上设定为仍能满足97%目标敏感度的最高值，并采用包含等号的比较。在测试集仅评分一次之前，模型选择、校准和阈值均已冻结。
【结果】在718张保留的测试图像上，转诊敏感度为97.0%（95% CI 95.1至98.2），特异度为75.6%（95% CI 69.4至80.8），异常与正常的AUROC为0.974；对测试集中363个相似性组进行聚类自助法后，这些区间分别扩大至93.8–99.6%和66.0–83.4%。在501只异常耳中，15只未被转诊；其中11只为鼓室硬化，无胆脂瘤。12类宏平均F1为0.686，平衡准确率为68.3%，准确率为85.0%（合并慢性亚型后为86.2%）。温度缩放（T = 1.2）使期望校准误差由0.0498降至0.0430。低置信度标记出现在4.0%的测试图像上，未标记病例的准确率为87.2%，而被标记病例为31.0%。

title: A review of deep learning applications on histopathologic and genomic data in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis.
zh_title: 局灶节段性肾小球硬化的组织病理与基因组深度学习应用综述
summary: 综述深度学习在FSGS组织病理和基因组数据中的应用，讨论该病病变检测与分类面临的局限。

abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis explains the histological pattern of injury seen through light microscopy in kidney biopsy specimens and is the end result of different injuries to podocytes. The clinical classification of patients by FSGS lesion is challenging because of a broad spectrum of etiologies, limited understanding of pathophysiology, and poor correlation among histopathology, treatment response, and clinical outcomes. Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis is a problematic process to detect lesions, with low and late analysis of the absence of initial symptoms, and a challenging position of specific markers. However, Histopathological and genomic Data in Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) are significantly used in multiple research applications, but they face several limitations that restrict the efficiency of experimental analysis. This review systematically analyzed recent enhancements in biopsy-based analysis and deep learning models for FSGS, with specific emphasis on different mechanisms. Moreover, this review analyzed different strategies, namely kidney transplantation, pathogenesis to therapeutic approaches, transformer-based architectures, glomerular segmentation methodologies, multitasking strategy classification, and gene expression analysis for FSGS. This review analysis includes 121 research papers, which are selected and analyzed for glomerular segmentation, gene expression, clinical outcomes, lesion classification, and disease recurrence prediction. Based on the recent research frameworks, it explicitly states the performance analysis, benefits, as well as challenges of FSGS. The article presents details of a new dataset and future directions for improving the majority of nephropathology diagnoses previously available through the use of integrated approaches that utilize both histopathology and genomics, enhancing future research direction in FSGS.
zh_abstract: [计算生物学与化学] 局灶节段性肾小球硬化（FSGS）解释了肾活检标本光镜下所见的组织学损伤模式，是足细胞多种损伤的最终结果。由于病因谱广泛、对病理生理的理解有限，且组织病理学、治疗反应与临床结局之间相关性较差，按FSGS病变对患者进行临床分类具有挑战性。FSGS的病变检测是一个难题：初始症状缺失导致分析不足且较晚，特异性标志物的定位也很困难。然而，FSGS的组织病理学和基因组数据已被大量用于多种研究应用，但仍面临若干限制实验分析效率的局限。本综述系统分析了基于活检的分析和FSGS深度学习模型的最新进展，并特别强调不同的机制。此外，本综述分析了多种策略，即肾移植、从发病机制到治疗方法、基于transformer的架构、肾小球分割方法、多任务策略分类以及FSGS的基因表达分析。本综述共纳入并分析121篇研究论文，涉及肾小球分割、基因表达、临床结局、病变分类和疾病复发预测。基于近期的研究框架，文章明确阐述了FSGS的性能分析、益处和挑战。文章介绍了一个新数据集的细节和未来方向，以通过整合组织病理学和基因组学的方法改进此前已有的大多数肾脏病理诊断，从而促进FSGS未来的研究方向。

title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis
zh_title: 结合SHAP可解释性与多特征的MRI脑肿瘤检测
summary: 预印本比较LBP、Gabor、小波、FFT、CNN等多种特征表示与KNN、随机森林、SVC、PNN、CNN等算法，报告LBP结合SVC和CNN表现较好，并用SHAP解释。

LBP结合SVC和CNN特异度与准确率较高
使用SHAP进行可解释性分析

abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. zh_abstract: 医学影像领域的最新创新显著改善了脑肿瘤的识别，超越了存在分辨率低、辐射暴露和对比度有限等问题的传统诊断方法。磁共振成像（MRI）具有高分辨率和无创的特点，在精确、准确地表征肿瘤方面起着关键作用。本研究探讨了多种特征表示方案之间的协同作用，如局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度游程矩阵，并结合五种学习算法，即k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP结合SVC和CNN获得了较高的特异度和准确率，使其成为基于MRI的肿瘤诊断的一种有前景的方法。为进一步探究LBP的贡献，采用卡方检验和p值检验等统计分析，证实了LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别具有显著影响。此外，使用SHAP分析来识别分类中最重要的特征。在一个小数据集中，CNN获得了97.8%的准确率，而SVC的准确率为98.06%。在后续分析中，还利用了一个大型基准数据集来评估学习算法的性能，以考察所提模型的泛化能力。CNN取得了最高的准确率98.9%，其次是SVC，为96.7%。这些结果凸显了CNN在自动化、高精度肿瘤诊断中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection

title: What Patients Say They Can't Access: Mining Cancer Screening Barriers from Online Communities
zh_title: 从在线社区挖掘癌症筛查障碍
summary: 分析六个癌症Reddit社区逾5.6万条帖子，从576条美国帖子中归纳患者自述的癌症筛查障碍。
key_points: 关键词过滤、障碍分流、开放编码与编码本合成
识别结构性、信息性和心理社会性障碍

abstract: Cancer screening disparities persist across the U.S., yet the patient-reported barriers driving low uptake remain poorly characterized at scale. While clinical surveys capture structured responses, they miss the organic, unsolicited discourse where patients candidly describe real-world obstacles. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale analysis of over 56,000 posts across six cancer-specific Reddit communities to surface barriers to cancer screening among U.S. patients. We apply a pipeline combining keyword filtering, barrier triage, open coding, and codebook synthesis to systematically extract and categorize patient-reported barriers from 576 U.S.-located posts. Our qualitative analysis reveals recurring structural, informational, and psychosocial barriers that vary meaningfully by cancer type and community context. These findings lay the groundwork for future work aimed at proactively identifying and addressing barriers at scale - spanning a broader range of cancer types and populations - and informing the design of targeted interventions, navigator programs, and health system policies that translate patient-reported obstacles into actionable solutions.
zh_abstract: 美国各地的癌症筛查差异持续存在，但导致筛查率低的患者自述障碍在大规模层面上仍缺乏充分刻画。临床调查虽能获得结构化应答，却遗漏了患者坦率描述现实障碍的自发、非诱导性讨论。本文对六个癌症专属Reddit社区中的5.6万多条帖子进行了大规模分析，以揭示美国患者在癌症筛查中的障碍。我们采用结合关键词筛选、障碍分诊、开放编码和编码手册综合的流程，从576条位于美国的帖子中系统提取并归类患者自述的障碍。我们的定性分析揭示了反复出现的结构性、信息性和心理社会性障碍，这些障碍因癌症类型和社区背景而有显著差异。这些发现为今后的工作奠定了基础，即在更广泛的癌症类型和人群中大规模主动识别并应对障碍，并为有针对性的干预措施、导航员项目以及卫生系统政策的设计提供依据，将患者自述的障碍转化为可行的解决方案。

title: Responsible GenAI Use During Active Armed Conflict: Evidence from Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms
zh_title: 武装冲突期间负责任使用生成式AI：来自苏丹紧急响应室的证据
summary: 通过89人问卷和15次访谈，研究苏丹社区人道响应者在冲突中使用生成式AI的情况及其可验证性问题。
key_points: 89名问卷受访者
15次半结构化访谈
输出越难验证时越常被使用
reason: 小样本定性研究，与医疗关联较弱，属增量档
abstract: Armed conflict can increase the value of Generative AI (GenAI) while undermining the conditions required for its responsible use. Yet the perspectives of community-based humanitarian responders working under these conditions remain underrepresented in responsible AI research. We examine GenAI use in Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms (ERRs), a community-led humanitarian network, through an exploratory survey of 89 respondents and 15 semi-structured interviews with GenAI users and non-users. War reconfigures GenAI's role, making it most useful where its outputs are hardest to verify. ERR responders turned to GenAI when conflict made human expertise difficult or dangerous to reach. However, participants cautioned that GenAI could not independently establish rapidly changing local conditions, and that relying on its outputs could lead to harmful decisions when human verification was difficult. Risks arose before GenAI was used. For some volunteers, carrying a phone or accessing the internet could expose them to danger. Others were concerned that sharing sensitive beneficiary or operational information with GenAI could put people at risk. Participants feared that AI-assisted reports could undermine their credibility with donors, whose funding sustains the food and medical aid ERRs provide. Access to GenAI was uneven, and volunteers using it sometimes relied on colleagues with relevant expertise or local knowledge to verify its results. Our findings show that responsible use of GenAI during conflict depends not only on model performance or individual adoption, but also on whether responders can safely access these tools, verify their outputs against local conditions, and recognize when limiting or avoiding GenAI is the more responsible choice.
zh_abstract: 武装冲突可能提高生成式人工智能（GenAI）的价值，同时削弱负责任使用它所需的条件。然而，在这些条件下工作的社区型人道主义响应者的观点，在负责任人工智能研究中仍未得到充分体现。我们通过对 89 名受访者的探索性调查，以及对 GenAI 使用者和非使用者的 15 次半结构化访谈，考察了苏丹紧急响应室（ERRs，一个由社区主导的人道主义网络）中 GenAI 的使用情况。战争重塑了 GenAI 的角色，使其在输出最难验证之处最为有用。当冲突使人类专家难以或危险接触时，ERR 响应者转而使用 GenAI。然而，参与者提醒，GenAI 无法独立确认快速变化的当地情况，而在难以进行人工核实时，依赖其输出可能导致有害决策。风险在使用 GenAI 之前就已出现：对一些志愿者而言，携带手机或上网本身就可能使其面临危险；另一些人担心，将敏感的受益者或行动信息分享给 GenAI 可能使人们陷入危险。参与者担心，AI 辅助的报告可能损害他们在捐助者面前的可信度，而捐助者的资金支撑着 ERR 提供的食品和医疗援助。GenAI 的获取并不均衡，使用它的志愿者有时依靠具备相关专业知识或当地知识的同事来核实结果。我们的研究结果表明，冲突期间负责任地使用 GenAI，不仅取决于模型性能或个人采用，还取决于响应者能否安全地获取这些工具、对照当地情况核实其输出，以及能否认识到限制或避免使用 GenAI 何时才是更负责任的选择。

title: Task-Aware Bitrate Thresholds for Codec-Robust Ultrasound Segmentation
zh_title: 面向超声分割的任务感知码率阈值
summary: 在前列腺超声分割上比较H.264、HEVC和AV1编码器，以Dice和HD95确定各编码器保持可接受分割精度的最低码率。
key_points: 在相同SSIM水平下匹配编码器工作点
报告Dice均值及第5百分位以显示最差退化
面向远程手术与远程超声的带宽受限场景
reason: 小范围评测研究，增量性，预印本
abstract: Remote robot surgery and tele-ultrasound increasingly rely on real-time streaming under strict bandwidth constraints, making lossy compression unavoidable. Since the receiving end of these clinical pipelines is increasingly a machine rather than a human observer, codec selection must be guided by downstream task accuracy rather than perceptual fidelity. We evaluate three widely deployed codecs, H.264/AVC, HEVC, and AV1, on prostate ultrasound segmentation, reporting task-aware compression performance with region overlap (Dice) and boundary accuracy (HD95) as the quality metrics. To compare codecs fairly, we match their operating points at a common perceptual-quality (SSIM) level. We establish, per codec, the lowest bitrate that preserves acceptable segmentation accuracy, reporting the 5th-percentile Dice alongside the mean to expose worst-case degradation. All three codecs preserve segmentation quality (mean Dice $\geq$ 0.84) down to approximately 0.07-0.20 bits per voxel (bpv). Below this point, AV1's accuracy declines gradually, while H.264's drops sharply. As a result, H.264 needs 82% more bitrate than AV1 to reach the same region-overlap accuracy (Dice), and 104.7% more to reach the same boundary accuracy (HD95).
zh_abstract: 远程机器人手术和远程超声越来越依赖严格带宽限制下的实时流传输，因此有损压缩不可避免。由于这些临床流程的接收端越来越多地是机器而非人类观察者，编解码器的选择应以下游任务准确性而非感知保真度为指导。我们在前列腺超声分割上评估了三种广泛部署的编解码器：H.264/AVC、HEVC 和 AV1，以区域重叠度（Dice）和边界准确度（HD95）作为质量指标，报告任务感知的压缩性能。为公平比较各编解码器，我们在共同的感知质量（SSIM）水平上匹配其工作点。我们为每种编解码器确定能够保持可接受分割准确性的最低码率，并在报告均值的同时报告第 5 百分位的 Dice，以揭示最坏情况下的性能退化。三种编解码器在降至约 0.07–0.20 比特每体素（bpv）之前均能保持分割质量（平均 Dice ≥ 0.84）。低于该点后，AV1 的准确性逐渐下降，而 H.264 则急剧下降。因此，要达到相同的区域重叠准确度（Dice），H.264 所需码率比 AV1 高 82%；要达到相同的边界准确度（HD95），则高 104.7%。

title: Can large language models improve the quality and efficiency of health policy surveillance?
zh_title: 大模型能否提升卫生政策监测的质量与效率？

探讨大模型在法律数据收集与编码中的用途
讨论需解决的潜在挑战

abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Legal epidemiology is a growing field wherein researchers examine the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Policy surveillance is a key part of the legal epidemiology process and leads to the creation of a legal dataset for econometric analyses. Policy surveillance includes conceptualizing the research scope, collecting legal data, and coding data to answer legal questions. Historically, policy surveillance has been slow and time-consuming, limiting timely information about the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Researchers are exploring the role of artificial intelligence using large language models (LLMs) to increase the efficiency and quality of the policy surveillance process. In this commentary, we describe potential uses of LLMs by researchers conducting policy surveillance as well as potential challenges that will need to be addressed before LLMs are widely used in the process. We also suggest areas for future research while emphasizing the need for development of guidelines for LLM use in policy surveillance.
zh_abstract: [Health affairs scholar] 法律流行病学是一个不断发展的领域，研究者在其中考察卫生政策对健康结局的影响。政策监测是法律流行病学过程的关键部分，可形成用于计量经济学分析的法律数据集。政策监测包括确定研究范围、收集法律数据，以及对数据进行编码以回答法律问题。过去，政策监测进展缓慢且耗时，限制了关于卫生政策对健康结局影响的及时信息。研究者正在探索使用大语言模型（LLM）的人工智能在提高政策监测过程效率和质量方面的作用。在这篇评论中，我们介绍了开展政策监测的研究者使用LLM的潜在用途，以及在LLM被广泛用于该过程之前需要解决的潜在挑战。我们还提出了未来研究的方向，同时强调需要制定政策监测中使用LLM的指南。

title: Application of Machine Learning and Deep Learning in diagnosis Covid19
zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习在COVID-19预后预测中的应用

abstract: Predicting the progression of COVID-19 in hospitalised patients was an important challenge during the pandemic, particularly when healthcare resources were limited. This study investigates the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to predict three clinical outcomes: death, admission to the intensive care unit (ICU), and clinical status (improvement or worsening). The study uses two patient datasets: an Algerian cohort of 80 patients from the Internal Medicine Department of the University Hospital Centre of Constantine, collected between July and August 2020, and a French cohort of 99 patients collected between March and May 2020. Five ML classifiers were evaluated: logistic regression (LR), k-nearest neighbours (KNN), classification and regression trees (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and support vector machines (SVM). Their performance was examined in combination with three feature-selection methods: analysis of variance (ANOVA), mutual information (MI), and recursive feature elimination (RFE). The results were also compared with multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using one to five hidden layers. Model evaluation included 30 repetitions of five-fold cross-validation on the training data, followed by evaluation on a separate hold-out test set. The results showed that selecting 20 features generally provided better cross-validated accuracy than selecting 30 features or using the full feature set. The best-performing classifier-feature-selection combination varied across the six dataset-outcome tasks. LR combined with RFE was selected for three tasks, LR combined with ANOVA for one task, and CART combined with ANOVA for two tasks. The selected ML models achieved test-set accuracies ranging from 0.47 to 0.95 and higher accuracy than the average MLP results in five of the six tasks. These findings suggest that ML methods can be useful for exploring clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients. However, the small sample sizes and limitations of the available data mean that the results should be interpreted with caution. Further evaluation using larger and independent patient datasets is needed before these models can be considered for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 预测住院COVID-19患者的病情进展是大流行期间的一项重要挑战，在医疗资源有限时尤为如此。本研究探讨利用机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型预测三种临床结局：死亡、入住重症监护病房（ICU）以及临床状态（改善或恶化）。研究使用两个患者数据集：一个是阿尔及利亚队列，包含2020年7月至8月间在君士坦丁大学医院中心内科收集的80例患者；另一个是法国队列，包含2020年3月至5月间收集的99例患者。研究评估了五种ML分类器：逻辑回归（LR）、k近邻（KNN）、分类与回归树（CART）、朴素贝叶斯（NB）和支持向量机（SVM）。并结合三种特征选择方法考察其性能：方差分析（ANOVA）、互信息（MI）和递归特征消除（RFE）。结果还与采用一至五个隐藏层的多层感知机（MLP）模型进行了比较。模型评估包括在训练数据上进行30次重复的五折交叉验证，随后在独立的留出测试集上进行评估。结果显示，选择20个特征通常比选择30个特征或使用全部特征获得更好的交叉验证准确率。在六个数据集—结局任务中，表现最佳的分类器—特征选择组合各不相同：三个任务选用LR结合RFE，一个任务选用LR结合ANOVA，两个任务选用CART结合ANOVA。所选ML模型在测试集上的准确率为0.47至0.95，且在六个任务中的五个任务中准确率高于MLP的平均结果。这些发现提示，ML方法可用于探索住院COVID-19患者的临床结局。然而，样本量小以及可用数据的局限性意味着对结果的解读应持谨慎态度。在这些模型可考虑用于临床之前，需要使用更大规模的独立患者数据集进行进一步评估。
